chapters: Jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maakobh jixchamaam kua' tu' tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan ju'ñdharan gɨ' suudai' jiim gu Kebar gu tɨkɨr gu ñi'ook tu' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jixchamaam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't jixchamaam oi'ñga' gu gɨ'kora' gu Joakîn.
Jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Esekieel jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu mar gu Busi gu oidha' gu Kaldeos ju'ñdharan gɨ' suudai' jiim gu Kebar; gio ba' ka't bhaan gu novɨ gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu jɨvɨl toov bɨɨx gu tai tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tai na ja'p.
Jano' ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maakobh gu vaakax; gio ba' dhi' ka't; mi' dhɨr ka't na jax chu'm gu chio'ñ.
Jano' ba' maa'n ga'ra' maakobh gu vupui maakobh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' tɨɨt jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaas tɨɨt na ja'p gu vaas tɨɨt tuur; gio ba' jix vɨgɨ jodai gu bhóogɨt gu jodai' na jix uam.
Jano' ba' bɨtaa'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maakobh ko'kmarak gu noobh gu chio'ñ; gio ba' gu vupui maakobh.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook maa'n; na pai' dhuuk cham na pai' dhuuk jiim; mi' dhɨr maa'n gu ñi'ook gu vupui.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vupui ka't gu vupui gu chio'ñ; gio ba' gu vupui maavɨt baasɨ'n tu jiim maakobh; mi' dhɨr o'nsop gu vupui gu vaakax maakobh; jano' ba' ka't maakobh gu vupui gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu vupui; gio ba' ko'kmarak tu jiim maa'n gook gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gook gu ñi'ook gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' maa'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu vupui; gio ba' bhaan pai' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ ka't jiim; na pai' dhuuk jiim cham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na jax chu'm gu vaakax ka't na ja'p gu tai na ja'p; gio ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaakax; mi' dhɨr gu tai gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu tai jix buus.
Jano' ba' gu vaakax jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na jax chu'm.
Jano' ba' kua' tu' tɨɨgɨk gu vaakax gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu oidha' ju'ñdharan gu vaakax maakobh.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jix uam jodai na jix uam; gio ba' maakobh ko'kmarak na jax chu'm; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk jiim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan maakobh; na pai' dhuuk cham na pai' dhuuk jiim.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' jix bhuup gu vupui xikoolh maakobh.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu vaakax jiim gu ñi'ook jiim ju'ñdharan; na pai' dhuuk gu vaakax gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' bhaan pai' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jiim; gio ba' bhaan pai' ka't gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook gio gu ñi'ook bhaan; na gu' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu vaakax ka't gu ñi'ook.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk jiim; na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook; na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu ñi'ook bhaan; na gu' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu vaakax ka't gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' bhaan ɨɨbhidham gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tɨkɨr jix gɨ' bhai' tu jiim bhaan ɨɨbhidham.
Jano' ba' bɨtaa'n gu tɨkɨr mi'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' maa'n gook bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu chuukug.

Na pai' dhuuk tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na pai' dhuuk jiim na ja'p mumua'da' gu suudai' na ja'p gu ñi'ook gu Omnipotente na ja'p tɨroon na ja'p gu ñi'ook ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham; na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook jix duñia'.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jiix gu tɨkɨr ka't bhaan ɨɨbhidham.
Jano' ba' bhaan gu tɨkɨr ka't bhaan ɨɨbhidham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam atooxkor gu jodai jodai na jix tɨkɨr; gio ba' bhaan atooxkor ka't na jax chu'm gu chio'ñ daakat bhaan.
Jano' ba' tu' gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p gu ñi'ook gu tai gu ñi'ook na ba' jiix; gio ba' dɨr gu ñi'ook na ba' gu ñi'ook tu' na ja'p gu tai ga'ra' xikoolh.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tɨkɨr tɨbaa'ñ gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't xikoolh; gio ba' dhi' ka't gu ñi'ook na jax chu'm gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr tu' buupui bhaan gu vupui tu' gu ñi'ook maa'n ua'rgidhimɨk.
Jano' ba' gu Diijome; gio ba' gu mar gu chio'ñ bhaan tɨɨt tu ñi'ook bɨndak.
Ba' jix aa' chɨbiapui gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan tɨɨt ua'rgidhimɨk.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu mar gu chio'ñ tu' jootsa' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel chɨbɨɨp gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bhaan tu'; mi' dhɨr tattat jix duñia' bhaan tu' bɨɨx ka'm dhi' gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' tu' jootsa' gu ma'nkam jix bhai'x gu vupui gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' daipu'; mi' dhɨr tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' tu' cham na gu' ja'tkam vaak bɨɨx tas jix maati' ka't jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan tɨjɨɨ'ñ.

Jano' ba' tu' gu mar gu chio'ñ cham jum i'obh tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ɨɨbhi'ñ gu ñi'ook tu' tɨjɨɨ'ñ jo'ii' tu' jix duñia' bɨɨx; na gu' cham ɨɨbhi'ñ gu ñi'ook tu' jum i'obh vupui bhaan na gu' gu vaak.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix kai; na gu' gu bhóogɨt.
Gu' gu' tu' gu mar gu chio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' chɨɨdaim; gio ba' cham tu' na ja'p gu vaak; mi' dhɨr gu chin jugi tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ ka't u'uan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan tu' ka't ua'nak vupui bhaan; gio ba' ka't ua'ñix gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Diijome; gio ba' gu mar gu chio'ñ jugi bakia'; mi' dhɨr jugi dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chin tu' jugi mii' dhɨr.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu mar gu chio'ñ gu vupui vook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' ba'k dhi' tu'; mi' dhɨr ka't gu chin jix bhai'x na ja'p gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu mar gu chio'ñ tu' ba'k gu vaak gu Israeel tu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' na gu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam tu ñi'ook tu' nɨɨn gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' cham mui'x gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook tu' nɨɨn gu ñi'ook cham; gio ba' tu'.
Na gu' gu' gu vaak gu Israeel cham tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na gu' cham tu'; na gu' bɨx gu vaak gu Israeel jix bhai'x gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tu' gu vupui jix kavɨk bhaan gu vupui jix bhai'x jix kavɨk bhaan jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' na ja'p jodai na jix kavɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix kavɨk gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x; na gu' cham jum i'obh tu' ɨɨbhi'ñ vupui bhaan na gu' gu vaak.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu mar gu chio'ñ jix bhɨɨ gu i'ii'ñ bɨx gu ñi'ook tu' tu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx maatɨt.
Jano' ba' tu' ba'k bhaan gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam tu ñi'ook daipu'; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix kai.
Jano' ba' jix búup gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ñi'ook jix gɨ' chɨtda; gio ba' ka't gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Jawatan Dios dɨr pai'.
Jano' ba' tu' gio gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaakax bɨɨx gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan jix gɨ'.

Jano' ba' jix búup gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ jix bhɨɨ; gio ba' jix duñia' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ; gu' gu novɨ gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix kavɨk bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu Telabib ju'ñdharan gɨ' suudai' jiim gu Kebar pai' mi'p kɨɨv gu tanoolh tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kɨɨv gu tanoolh ka't tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bham.
Jano' ba' gu mar gu chio'ñ tu' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu Israeel; gio ba' tu' gu ñi'ook gu chin jix duñia' baasɨ'n.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk tu' tu ñi'ook jix bhai'x; gio ba' tɨɨda' koi; mi' dhɨr tu' cham jix duñia' tu' ñiokda' na ba' jix bhai'x ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham bhai' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu tai jix bhai'x koi tu' na cham jir bhai' gu' gu ɨ'ɨr gu novɨ.
Jano' ba' tu' jix duñia' jix bhai'x cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham bhai' gu bhóogɨt koi tu' na cham jir bhai' tu' gu i'ii'ñ.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk jir bhai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx bhai' tu' jix duñia' tu' na cham jir bhai' tu' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n vupui bhaan koi na gu' tu' cham; gio ba' uañi'ñ koi bɨx bhai' ka't gu ñi'ook cham aajim chɨ'ñchoka'; gu' gu ɨ'ɨr gu novɨ.
Na gu' tu' jir bhai' jix duñia' na ba' jir bhai' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham tɨɨda' ii'mdagaram na gu' ka't jix duñia'; gio ba' tu' gu i'ii'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' ka't gu novɨ gu Jawatan Dios bhaan tu'; gio ba' bamii' jix buus yooxi' tu ñi'ook bɨndak.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam yooxi'; gio ba' ka't gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p gɇ'kamtu'nda' ka't buupui ju'ñdharan gɨ' suudai' jiim gu Kebar; mi' dhɨr bhaan gu vupui.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' chɨbiapui gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan tɨɨt; gio ba' ba'k gu ñi'ook gu vaak.
Jano' ba' tu' gu ñi'ook gu mar gu chio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' bhaan tu' bɨɨx tu' cham tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam nɨɨn dhi' jix bhai'x cham ka' gu chio'ñ; na gu' gu vaak.

Na pai' dhuuk gu' na pai' dhuuk tu' bhɨɨya' tu ñi'ook bhi'spio'kai gu chin daipu'; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; na gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook; na gu' gu vaak.
Jano' ba' tu' gu mar gu chio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan tu' bhaan kiicham gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan jix duñia' bhaan gu kavɨk jix buusñi bhaan vupui bhaan yooxi' bhaan xikoolh.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gio jix kavɨk jodai pai' vaak jodai jix kavɨk jodai tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' kiicham; gio ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu vupui bhaan ka't pai' jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr nɨi'ñchudat gu vaak gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu ñi'ook bhaan tu' na cham jir bhai' gu vaak gu Israeel; gio ba' jɨɨ'ñdhidha' gu tanoolh bhaan tu' tu' na cham jir bhai'.
Jano' ba' tu' jix maa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' na cham jir bhai' jɨɨ'ñdhidha' gu tanoolh vaik gu tanoolh; gio ba' tu' na cham jir bhai' gu vaak gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' ja'tkam bhaan gu ñi'ook gookim jix duñia' tu' na cham jir bhai' gu vaak gu Judaa oo'm gu tanoolh; gio ba' gu tanoolh oi'ñga' gu tanoolh oi'ñga' tu' jix maa.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Jerusalem gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu vupui jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bhaan tu' cham tu' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm cham tu'x jai'ch jix duñia' gu tanoolh jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' tu' jix bhɨɨ na ba' tu' tiriik kai' vaas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu takarui' jɨɨ'ñdhidha' gu tanoolh bhaan gu ñi'ook; gio ba' vaik gu tanoolh jugi.
Jano' ba' jugi ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jugi.
Jano' ba' i'i gu suudai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n baasɨ'n; gio ba' gu ñi'ook i'i.
Jano' ba' jugi gu takarui' kai' vaas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨtaa'n maatai; gio ba' ñiata bɨɨx gɨgɨ'lhi'ñ gu chio'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jugi gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu takarui' ñaanbi' tɨjɨɨ'ñ chɨbɨɨp pai' u'u kavɨk tu'.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ cham gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a tu' cham pai' dhuuk dɨr bɨɨx ka'm dhi' gu ñi'ook tu' cham pai' dhuuk gu chin chɨbiapui gu chuukug gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a.
Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu vaakax pai' gu chio'ñ gu takarui' bɨɨx.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu mar gu chio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu takarui' gu Jerusalem jugi gu takarui' bɨɨx; mi' dhɨr i'i gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu takarui' gu suudai' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook tu' na cham jir bhai'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu mar gu chio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhɨɨ tu jiim gu ñi'ook bhaan mo'o; gio ba' mi' dhɨr jix duñia'.

Na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam baasɨ'n gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu tai tɨjɨɨ'ñ kiicham na pai' dhuuk gu tanoolh jix duñia' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim baasɨ'n bɨɨx xikoolh; gio ba' baasɨ'n gu jɨvɨl tu' gu kuchii.
Jano' ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gio gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tai gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu tai bɨx gu vaak gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' dhi' gu Jerusalem; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ chɨbɨɨp oi'ñga'n xikoolh.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñi'ook na jir bhai' chɨbɨɨp oi'ñga'n xikoolh; na gu' jix duñia' ñi'ook na jir bhai' gu ñi'ook cham.

Na ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' chɨbɨɨp xikoolh cham jix duñia' gu ñi'ook tu' jix duñia' ñi'ook na tu a'ga tu' bhaan ñi'ook na tu a'ga chɨbɨɨp xikoolh jix duñia' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Miren tu' bhaan tu'; mi' dhɨr tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñi'ook na jir bhai' tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu vupui gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' cham pai' dhuuk tu' mɨɨjidha' nɨidhim kuiñcha bɨx.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tattat jugi gu ma'nkam tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu ma'nkam jugi tattat; gio ba' tu' ñi'ook na jir bhai' bɨx jɨbɨɨlh bɨx.
Na ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook xidhuu bɨɨx bɨx tu' gio; gio ba' gu vupui cham uañi'ñka' tu' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam baasɨ'n tu' koi gu ñi'ook bhiogi' ka't tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'; gio ba' baasɨ'n xikoolh tu'; mi' dhɨr baasɨ'n bɨx jɨbɨɨlh bhaan gu kuchii.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam i'iich gu ñi'ook gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim; na pai' dhuuk tu' gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook na pai' dhuuk jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oidha' jix gaki tɨjɨɨ'ñ chɨbɨɨp xikoolh tu' gu vupui bɨx.
Na pai' dhuuk ka' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook chɨbɨɨp xikoolh tu' na pai' dhuuk tu' jix duñia' tu' ñi'ook na jir bhai' i'iich tu' daak; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' bhaan bhiogi' ka't na ba' chajaañ na ba' cham tu' duu jano' ba' bhiogi' bhaan gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu ñi'ook bhiogi' gu vaakax tu'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu ɨ'ɨr gu ñi'ook tu'; mi' dhɨr bhaan tu'; jano' ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ka't tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bham.
Jano' ba' gu mar gu chio'ñ jix dhaas gu vupui bhaan gu kakkavɨk gu Israeel jix duñia' bhaan.

Jano' ba' daipu'; gio ba' gu kakkavɨk gu Israeel jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu kakkavɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; jano' ba' tu' jix ai bhaan gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tas ka't; gio ba' koko'kam vupui bhaan duiñxim.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chuukug koko'kam gu ma'nkam gu Israeel vupui bhaan duiñxim; gio ba' o'oo jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.

Jano' ba' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jɨ'dɨlh ka't oidha' jix gaki jodai maa'nkar Jawatan ka't na ba' ka't xoi'kam oidha' jix gaki jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; gio ba' ka't duiñxim; mi' dhɨr gu tas ka't buimɨi ka't.
Jano' ba' koko'kam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Na pai' dhuuk gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ chɨbɨɨp na pai' dhuuk ua'tulhi'ñ oi'ñga'n.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tɨjɨɨ'ñ chɨbɨɨp tɨjɨɨ'ñ ka't gu ñi'ook; na gu' tu' kuiñcha gu i'ii'ñ jix ai'chdhix tu' kuiñcha gu vupui bhaan duiñxim; mi' dhɨr gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a kuiñcha jix duu bɨx.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham jix duñia' tu ñi'ook ka't bhaan dhi' cham bhai'.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu novɨ bɨɨx tɨɨt tu'; na gu' gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Israeel bɨx na gu' bɨɨx bhiogi' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.
Na gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam koi gu ñi'ook; gio ba' mia'n; mi' dhɨr ua'tulhi'ñ mia'n koi bhiogi'; jano' ba'.

Na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios na pai' dhuuk koko'kam no'm tɨjɨɨ'ñ duiñxim jodai maa'nkar Jawatan bɨx jix bhai'x bɨx gu kakkavɨk bɨtaa'n bɨx gu u'u bɨtaa'n bɨx gu ñi'ook pai' jix maa gu ñi'ook gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a bɨx duiñxim.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ bhaan gu oidha' oidha' jix gaki pai' jix gaki bhaan gu Diblat bɨx; gio ba' jix maati' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' ka't tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bham.
Jano' ba' tu' gu mar gu chio'ñ tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu oidha' gu Israeel; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jupaabkamu'n bhaan maakobh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' jano' ka't gu ñi'ook bhaan tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan tu' i'iich tu' bhaan gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' bhaan tu' bɨx.
Jano' ba' gu vupui cham tu' uañi'ñka' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch; gio ba' va'k bhaan tu' gu bhóogɨt tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' no'm; mi' dhɨr tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham bhai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jupaabkamu'n cham bhai'.
Jano' ba' jupaabkamu'n gu ñi'ook jupaabkamu'n; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan tu'; mi' dhɨr jupaabkamu'n.

Jano' ba' gu xibh jupaabkamu'n na ba' tu' gu ñi'ook gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu oidha'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jupaabkamu'n mia'n gu tanoolh; mi' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu jodai' na jix uam cham bhai' ñi'ook bhaan gu kakkavɨk.
Jano' ba' jano' jootom gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim daak bhaan tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' i'iich tu' bhaan gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' gu vupui cham uañi'ñka' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch; gio ba' bhaan gu bhóogɨt bhaan tu' tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' ka't; mi' dhɨr tu' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh jupaabkamu'n; gio ba' tu' gu ñi'ook gu xibh; mi' dhɨr tu'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' tu' maa'n; mi' dhɨr tu'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tɨbiap gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh; na cham bi'iix cham; na gu' gu ñi'ook bhaan bɨx.
Na gu' na gu' bi'iix cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' ko'iix; na gu' gu ñi'ook bhaan bɨx cham ka't; mi' dhɨr kuiñcha gu ñi'ook gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kuu'ñdham na jix kavɨk bɨx tu'x cham; na gu' gu ñi'ook bhaan bɨx.
Jano' ba' mai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bhiogi'; na yooxi' koi; mi' dhɨr kiicham bhiogi' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam no'm bhaan gu kakkavɨk na ja'p giokda' bɨx maa'n gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu noobh ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p gu suudai' bɨx kɨkbok.
Jano' ba' jix duu jix duñia' gio gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha'; gio ba' bɨx gu vupui gu jodai' na jix uam bɨx ɨɨbhidham.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix toja jodai jix uam jodai ka't jix bhai'x; gio ba' jix toja jodai tu' jix uam jodai cham jix duñia' gu tanoolh i'iich gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr cham jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ tu' ba'k; na gu' tu' jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n na ba' tu' na cham jir bhai'.
Na gu' na gu' gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix dhaas tu' jix duu dhi'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu novɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kapbhai' na ba' jix bhai'x gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vupui pai' ɨxchuixim; na gu' jɨjɨkgɨm.
Jano' ba' gu vupui gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' gu oidha' jix bhuup ñi'ook na jir bhai' gu ɨ'ɨr kiicham jix bhuup gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tomaat gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu vaak; gio ba' vaak na jix bhaan ka't.
Jano' ba' chajaañ jupaabkamu'n; gio ba' gu ñi'ook bhai'x i'ii'ñ cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ɨlhdham bhaan gu ñi'ook ka't bhaan gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu' ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu ñi'ook jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan daraa.

Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu ñi'ook gu noobh gu ja'tkam gu oidha' ka't; gio ba' bhaan gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx ñi'ook na jir bhai'; mi' dhɨr tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' ka't xijumai oi'ñga' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xijumai jixchamaam ka't tu' daakat gu vaak daraa gu Judaa mi'p vupui bhaan tu' bhaan tu' gu novɨ gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na jax chu'm gu tai; gio ba' dɨr pai' gu ñi'ook na ba' gu ñi'ook gu tai; mi' dhɨr dɨr gu ñi'ook jiix na ja'p ñiata.

Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr na jax chu'm gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ jix bhɨɨ mo'o; gio ba' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tɨkɨr gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios gu Jerusalem ba'k ki'ñgob bhaan pai' ka't ba'bhak na jax chu'm jix duñia' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel na ja'p gu ñi'ook tu' ka't buupui yooxi'.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu mar gu chio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' gu vupui bhaan gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu vupui bhaan gu ñi'ook ju'ñdharan ki'ñgob jodai maa'nkar Jawatan na jax chu'm ba'k.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba'; gio ba' gu mar gu chio'ñ cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam suulhgia' xoi'kam gu vaak gu Israeel duñia' na ba' xidhuu gu' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ba'k.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu mar gu chio'ñ jix duñia' jano' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr ki'ñgob.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' ba'k tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam suulhgia' xoi'kam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu ko'oi gu vaakax bɨx duiñxim gu vaak gu Israeel mi'p xikoolh.
Jano' ba' vupui bhaan mi'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ daraa gu vaak gu Israeel gu Jaasaniias gu mar gu Sapaan ka't tɨjɨɨ'ñ maa'n bɨɨx vaak na jix bhaan gu novɨ; gio ba' gu ñi'ook.

Ba' jix aa'; na gu' gu mar gu chio'ñ buupui tu'x daraa gu vaak gu Israeel xoi'kam gu tukgam maa'n gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na gu' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr cham tu' gu Jawatan Dios; jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' tɨtda:―Cha'pim gu oidha'.
Ba' jix aa' mi' dhɨr; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook xoi'kam suulhgia'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ba'k ki'ñgob gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu u'vɨ mi'p gu Tammus.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu mar gu chio'ñ gu Bueelbete gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' ju'ñdharan ba'k vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios tɨjɨɨ'ñ ba'k jodai maa'nkar Jawatan na ja'p gu chio'ñ vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu vupui tas buusñi gu tas.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' cham buupui gu mar gu chio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' gu vaak gu Judaa bhaan xoi'kam mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu oidha' tu' na cham jir bhai'.
Na gu' gio tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam i'iich; gio ba' cham uañi'ñka' gu vupui tu' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch maatɨt bɨɨx gu ñi'ook cham tu jiim.
Jano' ba' gu Klamoo maatɨt bɨɨx gu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kiicham jix duñia' gu ñi'ook maa'n jix duñia' gu novɨ na ba' cham tu' duu.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ aajidha' gu bhóogɨt ki'ñgob jiix maa'n gu novɨ na ba' cham tu' duu; gio ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ ka't gu chio'ñ tɨi'chu' bhiibgich gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr ba'k gu ñi'ook ju'ñdharan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan jix vɨgɨ jodai.
Jano' ba' gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu ñi'ook bhaan ka't dhi' gu vaak; gio ba' jup tɨɨt gu Jawatan Dios gu chio'ñ tɨi'chu' bhiibgich ga'ra' gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ kiicham tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jerusalem nɨi'ñchudat jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ jix duñia' duuñ kuiñcha bɨx xoi'kam tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' maatɨt; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kiicham; mi' dhɨr cham gu vupui tu' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kɨklhi'ñga'n a'aalh gu u'vɨ bɨɨx ka'm cham jix duñia'; gu' bɨx mii' dhɨr bhaan bhɨɨya' nɨi'ñchudat cham; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' kua'da' dɨr xidhuu; jano' ba' kua'da' dɨr gu chio'ñ daraa mi'p vupui bhaan vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak jix bhuup koko'kam; mi' dhɨr; jano' ba' moor tu' kiicham.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' bhaan gu vupui tu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios cham tu' duu bɨx gu Israeel gu ñi'ook i'iich bhaan gu Jerusalem.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu' na cham jir bhai' gu vaak gu Israeel gu Judaa jix gɨ' daam gu oidha' jix bhuup gu ɨ'ɨr kiicham jix bhuup gu ñi'ook; na gu' jix duñia' tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' tɨtda:―Cha'pim tu' gu Jawatan Dios gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios cham tu'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu vupui cham uañi'ñka' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt bhaan mo'o.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ tɨi'chu' bhiibgich ga'ra' gu ñi'ook jix aa' gu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jurtu'nka' bɨx.
Jano' ba' gu Miree gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tɨkɨr ka't bhaan mo'o na ja'p gu jodai jodai na jix tɨkɨr na ja'p na jax chu'm atooxkor bhaan.
Ba' jix aa' gu chio'ñ tɨi'chu' bhiibgich; gio ba' ba'k tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨtaa'n tu' gu noobh tɨjɨɨ'ñ biiñ bhaan kiicham; mi' dhɨr chɨbiapui ñiata.
Na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mi'p gu novɨ tu jiim gu vaak na pai' dhuuk dhi' gu chio'ñ chɨbiapui; gio ba' toov.
Jano' ba' gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Jawatan Dios jix búup gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ki'ñgob; gio ba' gu vaak ka't jix bhuup toov jix bhuup gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Jawatan Dios.
Na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx ka'm na ja'p gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Omnipotente na pai' dhuuk tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ka't na ja'p jix aa'ñdhix gu chio'ñ tɨi'chu' bhiibgich bham; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ gu tai tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chɨbiapui gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tai ka't tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix bhɨɨ jix dhaas ka't tɨi'chu' bhiibgich jix bhɨɨ jix buus.
Jano' ba' jix ñi'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ bɨtaa'n.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maakobh gu ñi'ook ju'ñdharan gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook ka't na ja'p gu jodai gu Tarsis.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maakobh jix duñia' duñia' na ja'p tu' tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk jiim bhaan maakobh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jiim; na pai' dhuuk cham na pai' dhuuk jiim gu ñi'ook pai' maa'n jix duñia'; na pai' dhuuk tu' na pai' dhuuk jiim.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu chuukug gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu noobh gu ñi'ook jix bhuup ka't gu vupui xikoolh maakobh gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' maa'n ga'ra' maakobh gu vupui; gio ba' maa'n gu vupui ka't gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gook gu vupui gu chio'ñ; jano' ba' vaik gu vupui maavɨt; gio ba' maakobh gu vupui gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a.
Jano' ba' jix búup gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' dhi' gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n tu' gɨ' suudai' jiim gu Kebar.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk jiim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jiim gu ñi'ook ju'ñdharan bɨɨx; na pai' dhuuk na ba' gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu ñi'ook gio cham ju'ñdharan.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na pai' dhuuk bɨɨx; na gu' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu vaakax ka't.
Jano' ba' gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Jawatan Dios jix buus bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu ñi'ook bhaan.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix búup gu oidha' vupui bhaan gu vupui; na pai' dhuuk moor gio gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook ba'k ki'ñgob gu ux na tu ibai' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel ka't jiix bhaan.
Jano' ba' dhi' ka't gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n tu' bɨtaa'n gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel gɨ' suudai' jiim gu Kebar; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' maa'n ga'ra' maakobh gu vupui maa'n maakobh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu noobh bɨtaa'n.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vupui ka't gu vupui tu' ju'ñdharan gɨ' suudai' jiim gu Kebar; gio ba' maa'n gu ñi'ook gu vupui.

Jano' ba' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ki'ñgob gu ux na tu ibai' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios bhaan tas buusñi; gio ba' ba'k ki'ñgob gu chio'ñ tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu Jaasaniias gu mar gu Asur gu Pelatiias gu mar gu Benaiias chiñia' gu ja'tkam.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu mar gu chio'ñ dhi' ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Dan dhi' kiicham cham bhai'.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham ka't gu ñi'ook jootom; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak; jano' ba' ka't no'ch gu chuukug.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' bhaan jix duñia' gu mar gu chio'ñ.

Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan tu' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu'; mi' dhɨr tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; jano' ba' jix duñia' tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Israeel tu'x gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ tu' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam koko'kam dhi' kiicham jix duñia' koko'kam.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' koko'kam jix duñia' gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chuukug; gu' tu' jix buusñi tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu ñi'ook bhaan gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix buusñi tɨjɨɨ'ñ kapbhai' gu noobh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' ñi'ook na jir bhai' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Israeel tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' dhi' cham ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ñi'ook boopoya' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chuukug; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Israeel no'ñ gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' cham jix duñia' tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na jir bhai' gu ñi'ook bhaan ñi'ook na jir bhai' chɨbɨɨp xikoolh jix duñia' gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' ka't kua' tu' jix duñia' gu Pelatiias gu mar gu Benaiias jix koi; gio ba' jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu vupui tu ñi'ook bɨɨx jix gɨ' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr tu' gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios jix duu tu' bɨx gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' ka't tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bham.

Jano' ba' aajim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim bɨx.

Jano' ba' ka't tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bham.

Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx baakux.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xoi'kam bhaan mo'o.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' jix uam jodai jix toja jodai tɨi'chu' ka't; gio ba' tiriik gu ñi'ook bɨ'ñdhatu'; mi' dhɨr gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim bɨɨx ka'm.
Jano' ba' tu' jix buus gu tanoolh na jix bhai' tɨjɨɨ'ñ chɨbɨɨp kuiñcha gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' ka't kuiñcha tu' bhaan tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Gu' gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kuiñcha gu tanoolh na jix bhai' gu ñi'ook; gio ba'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jajannulhi'ñ tu' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' nɨidhim cham ɨlhdham tu' ka't.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix uam jodai jix toja jodai tu' ka't jix maa tu' gu chio'ñ bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jajannulhi'ñ jix uam; gio ba' bɨ'ñdhatu' vupui bhaan.

Jano' ba' gu takarui' gio tu' ka't jix maa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨ'ñdhatu' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx tu' vupui bhaan na ba' gu ñi'ook gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a; gio ba' ka't tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' gu ma'nkam ma'nkam u'uuvɨ maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan na ba'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook dhi'.
Jano' ba' maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan gu ma'nkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' gu ñi'ook gu tai.
Na pai' dhuuk bɨɨx bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham tu' gu tanoolh na pai' dhuuk dhi' na pai' dhuuk dhi' gu ɨ'ɨr.
Jano' ba' ka't mi' dhɨr bɨx tu' na cham jir bhai' gu ñi'ook tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x tu' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan bɨx.
Jano' ba' bɨx mo'o gu bhóogɨt gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu Ejipto gu chuukug; gio ba' na ba'.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix duñia' bhaan tu' gu novɨ tu' kapbhai' aagak ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu Pilisteos tu' gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gio bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu Assur cham; gio ba' bɨɨx tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam duñiixim gu oidha' gu Kanaan gu Kaldeos; gio ba' tu' bɨɨx dhi' tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios dhaibu gu ñi'ook bɨx dhi' tu'x buimɨi ganai'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jodai maa'nkar Jawatan mo'o bɨx gu bhóogɨt duñia' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham nɨidhim ganai' jix duñia'.
Na gu' gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu u'vɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na gu' pai' gu chio'ñ dhi'ñi.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dan juana'; gu' tu' chɨɨdak juana' bɨx; na gu' chɨɨdak na gu' ba'k tu' bɨx.
Jano' ba' tu' jix duñia' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu u'vɨ tu' cham pai' dhuuk mi' dhɨr tu' ka't jix duñia'; na gu' tu' juana' cham juana' tu' jix duñia'.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ganai' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu jodai' na jix uam tu' jix duñia' duiñxim gu ɨ'ɨr gu ma'nkam chɨɨdak.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' ju'ñdharan bɨx bɨɨx bɨx bɨɨx bɨx; gio ba' bhaan tu' xikoolh xi'ɨraam bɨx gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu ɨ'ɨr; gio ba' tu' gu ɨ'ɨr daak.
Jano' ba' tu' kapbhai' gu novɨ; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x jix duñia' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan tu' jix duu gu ñi'ook gɇ'kamtu'nda' tu'.
Jano' ba' jix duu jix tɨ'ɨ bhaan tu' gu masad gu ja'tkam tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu jodai tu' gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a bɨɨx u'uux.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu tai jix duu tu' ñi'ook na jir bhai' gu vupui mumua'da' gu u'vɨ; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ganai' tu' maa'n.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook daak bhaan tu'.
Na gu' na gu' cham tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh daak bɨx dhi' gu ñi'ook tu' gio gu bhóogɨt bhaan mo'o tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' tu' bhaan bɨx.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx tu' bham; gio ba' na ja'p gu naan jix duñia' mar u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' mar u'vɨ gu naan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu chio'ñ gu ma'nkam; gio ba' gu ja'tkam sɨspidhi'ñ tu' bɨpna' gu ma'nkam; mi' dhɨr gu naan ka't gu etea gu taat gu Amorreo.
Jano' ba' gu ja'tkam jix gɨ' gu Samaria bɨɨx ma'nkam u'uuvɨ jix daa gu novɨ o'nsop; gio ba' gu ja'tkam jix ali' tu' gu Sodoma bɨɨx ma'nkam u'uuvɨ jix daa gu novɨ tu jiim.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham gu bhóogɨt tu' bhaan; gio ba' va'k na ja'p tu' dhi' mai' jix bhai'x gu bhóogɨt jix bhai'x tu' bɨx gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu Sodoma gu ja'tkam bɨɨx ma'nkam u'uuvɨ cham tu' gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' ma'nkam u'uuvɨ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' ka't tu' na cham jir bhai' gu Sodoma gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu takarui' jix duñia' ma'nkam u'uuvɨ; mi' dhɨr cham gu novɨ gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix duu vupui bhaan tu' na ja'p tu' jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' gu Samaria cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tɨjɨɨ'ñ uañi'ñ; na gu' tu' sɨspidhi'ñ bɨɨx bɨx.

Jano' ba' tu' gio gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam sɨspidhi'ñ gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n xi'ɨraam uañi'ñ; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu'; mi' dhɨr gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a tu' gio gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu jodai' na jix uam sɨspidhi'ñ.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Sodoma ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu Samaria ma'nkam u'uuvɨ tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Na ba' na ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu jodai' na jix uam tu' gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a bɨx gu ñi'ook tu'.
Jano' ba' sɨspidhi'ñ gu Sodoma bɨɨx ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu Samaria bɨɨx ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu ñi'ook maa'n dhi'; gio ba' tu' gio ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'n dhi'.
Jano' ba' gu Sodoma gu ja'tkam cham ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chin gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' va'k tu' na cham jir bhai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p gu ñi'ook xi'ɨraam ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu Siria bɨx ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu Pilisteos xikoolh tu'.
Jano' ba' tu' baabuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' bɨndak na ja'p tu' gu ñi'ook na ba' ñi'ook na jix bhaan.
Jano' ba' va'k tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chɨ'ñchoka' ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨndak gu tanoolh tu' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim ñi'ook na jix bhaan.
Na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu bhóogɨt tu' gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a na pai' dhuuk makia' sɨspidhi'ñ tu' bɨɨx jix bhai'x tu' ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu' cham ñi'ook na jix bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨndak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Na pai' dhuuk na ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a cham pai' dhuuk gu chin kuiñcha xi'ɨraam na pai' dhuuk na ba' bɨndak bɨx tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' ka't tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bham.
Jano' ba' gu mar gu chio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ua'rgidhak gu vaak gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' daipu'; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr jix gɨ' gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tuttuidhix gu ñi'ook jix uam suudai' u'va gu Liibano jix bhɨɨ gɨ' u'u kavɨk.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' jix dhaas kiicham.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gio gu kai' gu oidha' jix dhaas yooxi' jix bhai' na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix dhaas ju'ñdharan gu suudai' jix dhaas na ja'p.
Jano' ba' jix duu jix buusñi tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' mamraga'n mi'p bɨtaa'n; na ba' jix duu.
Jano' ba' ka't jix gɨ' gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mumua'da'; gio ba' dhi' jum daa'ñ mia'n bhaan na ba' gu ux vaas na mi' oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' jix bhai' yooxi' ju'ñdharan mumua'da' gu suudai' ka't gu ux na tu ibai' na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu i'bhɨ na ba' jum duu.
Jano' ba' tu'; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham jix duñia' gu i'bhɨ gu Todas cham bɨɨx gu ñi'ook tu' bɨɨx gu ja'tkam.
Na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ux na tu ibai' ka't cham bɨx na pai' dhuuk gu jɨvɨl kuichdha'.
Jano' ba' ka't tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bham.

Jano' ba' tu' jano' gu vaak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' cham jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook dhi' tu'x gu Diles; mi' dhɨr gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia suudai' u'va gu Jerusalem jix bhɨɨ gu gɨ'kora' chiñia' baidhak gu Babiloonia.
Jano' ba' jix duu jix bhɨɨ gio gu kai' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' tu' bɨɨx ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ jix kavɨk gu oidha'.
Na ba' na ba' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' jum duu jix bhai'x cham gu ñi'ook jix nukadham ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook cham gu ñi'ook bhaan gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Ejipto na ba' koi kavaayo gu ja'tkam; gio ba' ka't gu ñi'ook dhi' tu'x jix duu ñi'ook na jix bhaan.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu ñi'ook tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios koi tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Babiloonia pai' gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨɨx.
Na pai' dhuuk cham bɨɨx jix gɨ' ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham tu' bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chu'p bɨɨx gu Faraoon na pai' dhuuk na ba' gu ñi'ook mumua'da'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook na ba' na pai' dhuuk ka't jix maa gu novɨ tu' bɨx dhi' tu'x cham gu ñi'ook.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook tu' jix duñia' bhaan mo'o.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan jix vɨgɨ ka't kuupka' cham bhai'; gio ba' jix duñia' jix ai gu Babiloonia dhi' ñi'ook na jir bhai' bɨɨx jix duñia' bɨɨx bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx bɨx ka't bɨx gu jɨvɨl; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mii' dhɨr jix bhai'x gɨ' u'u kavɨk; mi' dhɨr gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu i'ii'ñ jix duñia' gu ux na tu ibai' tu' bhaan gu kavɨk jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu kavɨk jix bhai'x gu Israeel gu ux na tu ibai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'bhɨ jix maat gɨ' u'u kavɨk; gio ba' bɨtaa'n bɨx gu u'uvhig bɨx da'a ɨkgiga'n.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu u'u yooxi' tu' gu Jawatan Dios gu u'u jix gaki gu u'u gu vaas tu' gu u'u jix gaki; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook tu'.
Jano' ba' ka't tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bham.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook ba'p gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' bhaan gu oidha' gu Israeel bham; gio ba' tattat koi'mɨk taatam gu ma'nkam namki'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios cham pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gui'x dhi' gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu Miren bɨx gu i'ii'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' na ja'p gu i'ii'ñ gu taat gu i'ii'ñ gu mar; mi' dhɨr gu i'ii'ñ koi.
Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ ua'tulhi'ñ jir bhai' tu' jix duñia' ñi'ook na jir bhai' bɨx bhai'.
Na cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu kakkavɨk tu' gu vupui duiñxim gu vaak gu Israeel tu' gu u'vɨ tɨtmo tu' gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' cham gu takarui' gu ñi'ook tɨbiaptuda bɨɨx tɨi'chu'.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' alhii; gio ba' tu' na cham jir bhai' gu novɨ tu' jix duñia' ñi'ook na jir bhai' tu'r tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chio'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' duñia' tu'r jir bhai'; gio ba' ii'mdagaram tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Gu' gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu mar ɨxkum gu ɨ'ɨr.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' va'k bhaan gu kakkavɨk gu u'vɨ tɨtmo.
Jano' ba' gampai' gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham gu vupui duiñxim tu' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam alhii; gio ba' ii'mdagaram cham ii'mdagaram; mi' dhɨr bɨx dhi' jix duu; jano' ba' tɨɨda' koi; gio ba' gu ɨ'ɨr ka't bhaan.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu mar jix duñia' bɨx uañi'ñ gu taat cham jix duñia' bhaan.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu kakkavɨk tu' gu vupui duiñxim gu vaak gu Israeel; gio ba' gu u'vɨ tɨtmo cham.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam soo'mchulhdhak; gio ba' cham gu jodai' na jix uam tu'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu takarui' tɨi'chu' tɨbiaptuda.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ gampai' tu' cham alhii; gio ba' jix duñia' cham koi tu' na cham jir bhai' gu taat; mi' dhɨr tɨɨda' ii'mdagaram.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu taat na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' xibhɨk tu' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam cham jix bhai' koi tu' na cham jir bhai'.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook; na gu' gu ñi'ook gu mar cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook uañi'ñ gu taat na gu' gu mar jix duu ñi'ook na jir bhai' bɨx bhai' nukadham bɨx tɨɨda' ii'mdagaram.
Jano' ba' gu i'ii'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam koi; gio ba' gu mar cham uañi'ñ gu taat tu' gu taat uañi'ñ gu mar; mi' dhɨr bɨx bhai' jir bhai' ka't bhaan jix bhai'x ka't bhaan.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu' jix bhai'x tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx uañi'ñ bɨx tu' jix duñia' ñi'ook na jir bhai' bɨx bhai' tɨɨda' ii'mdagaram; gio ba' cham koi.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham ka't; gio ba' bɨx bhai' jix duu ii'mdagaram.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu' koi'm jix bhai'x tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham ii'mdagaram tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu bhóogɨt.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu' tu' jir bhai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx bhai' tu' na cham jir bhai' tu' jix duñia' jurtu'nka' bɨx jix bhai'x ii'mdagaram gu Todas bɨx bhai' cham aajim chɨ'ñchoka'; gio ba' uañi'ñ bɨɨx jix duñia' uañi'ñ koi.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' jano' gu vaak gu Israeel; jano' ba' cham gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt cham gu bhóogɨt gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jir bhai' bɨx bhai' duñia' tu' na cham jir bhai' koi; gio ba' tu' na cham jir bhai' jix duu koi.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x duñia' ñi'ook na jir bhai' bɨx bhai' duaka' gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix duu na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix ai'chdhix bɨx tɨɨda' ii'mdagaram cham koi.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Israeel; gio ba' cham gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan; mi' dhɨr cham gu bhóogɨt gu vaak gu Israeel gu Kierto gu bhóogɨt cham.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' maa'n bhaan gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Israeel tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu ñi'ook bɨx gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr cham ka't gu ñi'ook kuiñcha.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bɨx tu' na cham jir bhai' bɨɨx jix duñia' duñia' gu i'ii'ñ jix vɨɨk gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ jix vɨɨk; gio ba' gu ñi'ook koi gu vaak gu Israeel.
Na cham gu ñi'ook koi'm kuusdaidha' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam duaka'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan chiñia' gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' daipu'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu naan tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duu.
Jano' ba' jix duu jix tɨ'ɨ maa'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' suudai' u'va gu chichio'ñ.
Jano' ba' chɨbɨɨp gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' ka't jix duñia' bɨɨx jix duñia' bhɨɨk bɨɨx gu oidha' gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix jai' gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh na jix bhai' nɨɨra jix bhɨɨ jix dhaas.
Jano' ba' jiim tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' jix duu gu chichio'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dɨ'dɨlhdhɨm jɨ'dɨlh; gio ba' gu oidha' ka't gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix maa bhaan chɨbɨɨp oidha' gɨ' xikoolh jix duñia' bhaan jix vɨgɨ; gio ba' ka't kuupka' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas kuupa' bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhɨɨk gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia; gio ba' na ba' gu ñi'ook cham bhaan gu kakkavɨk gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu naan ka't na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ɨ'ɨr gu ux na tu ibai' ju'ñdharan gu suudai' gu i'bhɨ kuiñcha mumua'da' gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' jix kavɨk na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan; gio ba' jix búup dhi' tu jiim tɨjɨɨ'ñ mamraga'n ka't ñiata gu ñi'ook bɨɨx.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx daak gu oidha' gu jɨvɨl gu i'bhɨ; gio ba' jix bɨɨx duu jix kavɨk; mi' dhɨr gu tai.
Jano' ba' jano' gu ux na tu ibai' oidha' jix gaki gu oidha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' tu' gu ñi'ook gu tai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu i'bhɨ cham tu' jix duñia' jix kavɨk na ba'; gio ba' dhi'.
Jano' ba' ka't oi'ñga' kɨɨv gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jixchamaam mambhɨɨx tɨɨtɨs dhɨt daraa gu Israeel gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix dhadhaa vupui bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' ka't tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bham.

Jano' ba' gu mar gu chio'ñ tu ñi'ook daraa gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Bibo tu' cham tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ñi'ook tu' gu mar gu chio'ñ gu Notipiikales tattat.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; na pai' dhuuk gu tanoolh gu Israeel gu novɨ gu kai' gu vaak gu Jakob jix duñia' gu oidha' gu Ejipto na pai' dhuuk gu novɨ bham; jano' ba' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ jix buusñi gu oidha' gu Ejipto gu oidha' ka't bii'm gu ñi'ook bɨx oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' maa'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vupui cham duiñxim gu Ejipto; mi' dhɨr tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.

Gu' gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan tu' cham; gio ba' cham jix duñia' maa'n gu vupui tu' gu ñi'ook duiñxim gu Ejipto; mi' dhɨr tu ñi'ook gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim daak bhaan na ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oidha' gu Ejipto.
Na gu' bɨɨx bɨx kuiñcha gu tɨɨgɨ' na gu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vupui chɨbɨɨp tɨjɨɨ'ñ mi'p gu vupui jix duñia' na ba' jix buusñi gu oidha' gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' gu Ejipto oidha' jix gaki.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ jix duñia' ii'mdagaram.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gio tas na jix bhaan bhaai'n nɨi'ñchudat tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' na ba' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.

Gu' gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan tu' gu vaak gu Israeel oidha' jix gaki; gio ba' cham jix duñia' gu chio'ñ jix duñia' ii'mdagaram; mi' dhɨr tas na jix bhaan; jano' ba' tu ñi'ook ka't gu ñi'ook bhaan daak oidha' jix gaki na ba'.
Na gu' gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tɨɨgɨ' na gu' cham ñiata chɨbɨɨp vupui bhaan gu vupui.
Jano' ba' gio tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ oidha' jix gaki cham gu oidha' tu' bii'm gu ñi'ook bɨx oi'ñga'n.
Na gu' na gu' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham tas na jix bhaan; na gu' bhaan duiñxim gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vupui cham tu' oidha' jix gaki.
Jano' ba' va'k tu ñi'ook oidha' jix gaki gu ma'nkam; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tattat tu' ñi'ook na tu a'ga tu' duiñxim.
Jano' ba' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu duukam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tas na jix bhaan ka't nɨi'ñchudat tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu ñi'ook na ba' dhiñ tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan tu'; gio ba' cham tu' nukadham na ba' jix duñia' tu duukam gu chio'ñ ii'mdagaram; mi' dhɨr tas na jix bhaan; jano' ba' tu ñi'ook jano' ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim daak bhaan na ba' oidha' jix gaki.
Na gu' gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ gu tɨɨgɨ' na gu' cham ñiata chɨbɨɨp vupui bhaan gu vupui.
Jano' ba' gio gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu novɨ oidha' jix gaki tɨjɨɨ'ñ chɨbɨɨp gu ñi'ook oi'ñga'n.
Na gu' na gu' cham jix dhaas gu ñi'ook tu duukam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' tas na jix bhaan bhaan duiñxim tattat jix bɨɨx duu gu vupui.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tu' gio tu' cham jix bhai' cham.
Na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'nkar na jix maa na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook gu tai bɨx maa'nkam mar na ba' gu ñi'ook tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu mar gu chio'ñ tu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Israeel; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; na pai' dhuuk dhi' tattat na pai' dhuuk bhaan tu' uañi'ñ.

Na gu' na gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' bhaan ka't gu novɨ ka't bɨx jix bhai'x bɨx gu u'u gu vaak na jix bhai' gu maa'nkar jix dhaas gio gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook gu vaak na jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x ka't tɨɨgim gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Bama bɨɨx ka'm gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' gu vaak gu Israeel; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tattat bhaan.

Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'nkar na jix maa gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu tai jix duñia' bɨɨx bɨx duiñxim bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu ñi'ook tu' gu vaak gu Israeel gu Bibo tu' gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios cham.
Jano' ba' cham tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia'; na gu' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr tu'ch na ja'p chɨbɨɨp na ja'p ja'tkam vaak gu ja'tkam gu u'u gu jodai.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu novɨ jix kavɨk gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaak na jix bhaan no'ñ gu ñi'ook bhaan gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix buusñi tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oi'ñga'n bɨɨx gu novɨ jix kavɨk gu ñi'ook vaak na jix bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oidha' jix gaki gu ja'tkam bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx tattat oidha' jix gaki gu oidha' gu Ejipto bɨɨx gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook bhaan tu'; gio ba' gu oidha' jix buusñi gu oidha' gu Israeel cham aajim; mi' dhɨr tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' cham tu'x jai'ch gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Israeel tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'n bhaan duiñxim tu' cham; mi' dhɨr cham jix bhaan gu tɨɨgɨ' bɨɨx maa'nkar na jix maa bɨɨx duiñxim.

Gu' cham gu ñi'ook jix bhaan gu kavɨk jix bhai'x gu kavɨk gu Israeel tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios tu juan bɨx gu vaak gu Israeel bɨx gu oidha'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'nkar na jix maa juana' bɨɨx bɨx tu'x.

Na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na pai' dhuuk bhɨɨya' jix buusñi tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam bhɨɨya' gu ñi'ook oi'ñga'n; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu vupui chɨbɨɨp.
Na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios na pai' dhuuk bhɨɨya' gu oidha' gu Israeel gu oidha' gu novɨ tattat.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu bhóogɨt bɨx; gio ba' boopoya' bɨx uañi'ñ.

Na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook xoi'kam gu tɨɨgɨ' cham bhaan gu bhóogɨt tomaat tu' bhaan buimɨi gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Israeel tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' ka't tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bham.
Jano' ba' gu mar gu chio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vupui bhaan saagi'ñ biiñ gu ñi'ook bhaan baasɨ'n jix duñia' bhaan yooxi' saagi'ñ.

Jano' ba' daipu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam saagi'ñ; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; jano' ba' tu' gu tai tu' bɨx gu u'u gu vaas bɨx gu u'u jix gaki; gio ba' cham mɨmɨim gu tai; mi' dhɨr ka't bɨx dɨr saagi'ñ bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu chuukug tu' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook tu'; mi' dhɨr cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ua'rgidhat.
Jano' ba' ka't tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bham.
Jano' ba' gu mar gu chio'ñ jix dhaas gu vupui bhaan gu Jerusalem biiñ gu ñi'ook bhaan vaak na jix bhaan jix duñia' bhaan gu oidha' gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' daipu' gu oidha' gu Israeel; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu Miren tu' bhaan tu' jix buusñi gu kuchii gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jir bhai' cham bhai' ja'tkam.
Na gu' na gu' jix duñia' tu' jir bhai' cham bhai' ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kuchii bhaan bɨx gu chuukug dɨr saagi'ñ bɨɨx ka'm.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu chuukug tu' gu Jawatan Dios gu kuchii; gio ba' cham.
Jano' ba' tu' gu mar gu chio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim; gio ba' vupui bhaan gu vupui.

Na pai' dhuuk ka't na pai' dhuuk tu' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' daipu'; mi' dhɨr gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n jupaabkamu'n; jano' ba' bɨx gu i'ii'ñ gu noobh bɨx gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ kɨkbok gu suudai'; gio ba' jupaabkamu'n jix duñia' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' ka't tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bham.
Jano' ba' gu mar gu chio'ñ jix duñia' tu'; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr tu'; jano' ba' gu kuchii gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Na ba' na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba'; gio ba' gu mar jupaabkamu'n bɨx gu u'u.
Jano' ba' jix maa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' jix xoi'kam gu novɨ; gio ba' gu kuchii na ba' kɨɨsa' gu novɨ.
Jano' ba' duuñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu mar gu chio'ñ; na gu' ka't bhaan gu ja'tkam ka't bhaan bɨx chiñia' gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr gu Temores gu kuchii ka't gu ja'tkam; na ba'.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' tu' gu kuchii cham ka't tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' tu' gu mar gu chio'ñ jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ bɨɨx gu kuchii jix duñia' gu kuchii koko'kam; gio ba' gu kuchii gu ñi'ook.
Na ba' na ba' gu i'ii'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' bɨx kiki'ñgob gu ñi'ook gu kuchii; mi' dhɨr tu' na ba'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam baasɨ'n kɨɨ'n bhaan pai' gu vupui.
Jano' ba' tu' gio gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ bɨɨx gu novɨ daak; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ka't tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bham.

Jano' ba' tu' gu mar gu chio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gook gu bhóogɨt pai' gu kuchii gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia; gio ba' gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu novɨ; jano' ba' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu bhóogɨt kiicham jix duu.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt nɨi'ñchudat gu ñi'ook pai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kuchii gu Rabba gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon gu Judaa bhaan gu Jerusalem jix kavɨk.
Na gu' na gu' gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gook gu bhóogɨt na ba'; gio ba' duiñxim gu tanoolh na jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu novɨ tu jiim bhaan gu Jerusalem na ba' bhi'spio'kai gu chin gu ñi'ook na ba' gu ñi'ook na ba' bhaan kiki'ñgob na ba' jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' ka' na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vupui bɨɨx gu ñi'ook; gu' jix duñia' chɨ'ñchoka' tu' na cham jir bhai' na ba' jix duñia'.

Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook jix ai chɨ'ñchoka' tu' na cham jir bhai' uañi'ñ buimɨi; na gu' jix duñia' tɨbiap chɨ'ñchoka' boopoya' gu novɨ.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' cham bhai' ja'tkam gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu Israeel gu tanoolh suudai' u'va gu ñi'ook tu' na cham jir bhai'.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kuruun; mi' dhɨr cham ka't; jano' ba' jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' cham ka't bɨɨx ka'm mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook kapbhai'.

Jano' ba' tu' gu mar gu chio'ñ jix duñia' tu'; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr daipu'; jano' ba' gu kuchii gu vai'ñga'n na kɨ'n tu joi'ñ na ba'; gio ba' na ba' bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook na ba' kapbhai' bɨɨx tomaat koi'm gu tanoolh suudai' u'va gu ñi'ook tu' na cham jir bhai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam pai' tu' gu oidha' pai' jix duñia' tu' no'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim bhaan tu' daak; gio ba' gu tai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duu bhaan tu' kapbhai' gu novɨ gu chichio'ñ chajaañ.
Jano' ba' gu tai ka' na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu ɨ'ɨr ka't tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr cham chɨ'ñchoka' tu'; na gu' tu' gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ka't tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bham.
Jano' ba' tu' gu mar gu chio'ñ cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' cham tu' kiicham gu ɨ'ɨr bɨx.
Jano' ba' daipu'; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr kiicham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ɨ'ɨr tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ba' gu tas jix duu duiñxim bhaan na ba'.
Jano' ba' gu ɨ'ɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam uañi'ñ tu' duiñxim; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook; na ba' tu' jix maa chɨbɨɨp bɨx oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' mia'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n jix gɨ'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chiñia' gu Israeel maa'n bhaan jix bɨɨx duu tu' na ba' gu ñi'ook gu ɨ'ɨr.
Jano' ba' gu taat gu naan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu'; gio ba' ja'tkam mii' dhɨr bɨɨx gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'; mi' dhɨr ja'tkam na jix xoi'kam tu'.
Jano' ba' vaak na jix bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tas na jix bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n ka't tu' na ba' gu ñi'ook gu ɨ'ɨr; gio ba' bhaan gu kakkavɨk koi'mɨk tu'; mi' dhɨr jix duu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu taat gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu'; gio ba' gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a tu'.
Jano' ba' jix duu maa'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu u'vɨ tɨtmo; gio ba' maa'n; mi' dhɨr maa'n tu' gu ja'tkam mar u'vɨ gu taat.
Jano' ba' u'uuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' na ba' gu ñi'ook gu ɨ'ɨr; gio ba' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ kuiñcha gu ɨ'ɨr jix bɨɨx duu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ gu noobh ka't jix kavɨk gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' bhaan tu' gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chɨbɨɨp tu' gu ñi'ook oi'ñga'n; gio ba' tu'.
Jano' ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu maa'nkar tu' gu vupui chɨbɨɨp; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' ka't tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bham.
Jano' ba' gu mar gu chio'ñ gu vaak gu Israeel tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' bɨx gu jodai' na jix uam dhi' jix kavɨk jodai tɨjɨɨ'ñ; mi' dhɨr jix toja jodai.
Na ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' bɨx jix duñia' gu ñi'ook tu' ju'ñdharan tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix toja jodai gu jodai' na jix uam jix kavɨk jodai dhi' tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ba' jix duu gu tai na ba'; gio ba' i'iich daak gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu ñi'ook gu tai i'iich tɨjɨɨ'ñ boopoya'.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix toja jodai tɨjɨɨ'ñ boopoya' tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios vaak na jix bhaan bhaan gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ka't tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bham.
Jano' ba' gu mar gu chio'ñ tu'; gio ba' tu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' na jix bhai' tu' jix duñia' bɨɨx dhuuk gu tanoolh i'iich.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ja'p maavɨt; gio ba' gu i'ii'ñ jix bhɨɨ nɨidhat dɨ'dɨlhdhɨm tɨjɨɨ'ñ.

Jano' ba' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan jix duñia' ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaak na jix bhaan; gio ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix bhaan cham jix duu tu' tɨjɨɨ'ñ ñaanbi'; mi' dhɨr tas na jix bhaan gu vupui tu' ka't tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' chiñia' tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ja'p sɨsɨɨ' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu ɨ'ɨr na ba' cham tu' duu gu i'ii'ñ na ba'.
Jano' ba' jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios cham ka't tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ja'tkam gu oidha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook ja'tkam mii' dhɨr cham gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ oidha' bhai' vupui bhaan tu' gu oidha' na ba' tu' cham; gio ba' cham gu ñi'ook.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan daak; gio ba' bɨɨx gu tai daak; mi' dhɨr gu bhóogɨt bhaan mo'o tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' ka't tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bham.
Jano' ba' gu mar gu chio'ñ ka't gook gu u'vɨ ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu naan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Ejipto; gio ba'; mi' dhɨr jix bɨɨx duu gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix gɨ' gu Aola gu ja'tkam gu Aoliba; gio ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam tu' ma'nkam u'uuvɨ; mi' dhɨr gu Samaria gu Aola; jano' ba' gu Jerusalem gu Aoliba.
Jano' ba' gu Aola gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam duñiixim; gio ba' gu Asirios.
Jano' ba' jajannulhi'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chiñia' biipibop bɨx kavaayo.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Asirios bɨɨx bɨx mii' dhɨr ja'tkam jix duñia'; gio ba' bɨɨx bɨx duiñxim.
Jano' ba' cham gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Ejipto; na gu' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook bhaan duñiixim.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kapbhai' gu novɨ gu ma'nkam gu Asirios ka't.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhɨɨ gu ma'nkam ma'nkam u'uuvɨ mu'aa; gio ba' suudai' u'va gu tɨɨgɨ' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu u'vɨ jix duu ñi'ook na jir bhai'.
Jano' ba' jix ñi' gu ja'tkam gu Aoliba gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xoi'kam; gio ba' gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ma'nkam gu Asirios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chiñia' jajannulhi'ñ kavaayo bɨx biipibop.
Jano' ba' tu' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt ka't.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na pai' dhuuk jix ñi' gu chichio'ñ gu Kaldeos jix uam.
Jano' ba' jix bhai'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook ɨɨbhidham ua'tulhdhidha' bɨx gu chichio'ñ gu Babiloonia gu oidha' gu Kaldeos.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhañ gu oidha' gu Kaldeos.
Jano' ba' baap gu chichio'ñ gu Babiloonia gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xoi'kam bɨɨx duñiixim; gio ba' gio bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix ñi'ñ; gio ba' gu i'ii'ñ na ja'p ka't tu' gu i'ii'ñ gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix mui' jix duñia' chɨ'ñchoka' gu tanoolh ka't jix duñia' gu oidha' gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chuukug na ja'p gu chuukug gu ñi'ook ɨ'ra'n na ja'p ɨ'ra'n kavaayo.
Na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chɨ'ñchoka' na pai' dhuuk gu Ejipto gu ñi'ook.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Aoliba tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' bhaan tu' gu ñi'ook tu' jix ai bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' gu Babiloonia bɨx gu Kaldeos gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chiñia' bɨx gu Asiria bɨɨx; gio ba' biipibop bɨx chiñia' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gɨ' kavɨk kavaayo bɨx.

Jano' ba' aajim bhaan tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a jix duñia' bhaan tu'; mi' dhɨr tu' ñi'ook na jir bhai' vupui bhaan ñi'ook na tu a'ga tu' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan tu' bɨndak bɨɨx i'iich; gio ba' jix duñia' daak; mi' dhɨr tu'; jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu ma'nkam ma'nkam u'uuvɨ ka't gu tai.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jajannulhi'ñ jix bhɨɨ gɇ'kamtu'nda'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' duñiixim gu oidha' gu Ejipto; gio ba' tu' gu vupui tu' cham pai' dhuuk tu' gu Ejipto.
Na gu' na gu' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' kapbhai' gu novɨ mii' dhɨr ja'tkam tu' gu novɨ mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨndak bɨɨx jix bhɨɨ bɨx tu' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim.
Na gu' dhi' tu'x jix duu bɨndak na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chɨbɨɨp bɨɨx tu' duiñxim.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' tu' gu novɨ.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' i'i gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr tu' chɨbɨɨp tu'; jano' ba' jix gɨ'.
Jano' ba' ka' jix bhuup gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam gu Samaria.
Jano' ba' i'i gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba'; na gu' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Na ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' tu' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x tu' baas bhaan gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n tu' gio.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu mar gu chio'ñ cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu Aola gu Aoliba.
Na gu' na gu' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham tu'x jai'ch gu ɨ'ɨr gu noobh jix duñia' bɨɨx duiñxim; gio ba' gu ma'nkam jix duu gu ñi'ook gu tai.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' jix duu; gio ba' xidhuu mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh tas na jix bhaan.
Na gu' dhaibu maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan gu ma'nkam duiñxim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xidhuu gu tanoolh na ba'; gio ba' jix duu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaak.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mɨjɨ gu chichio'ñ jupaabkamu'n ka't jix duñia' mattuda'; gio ba' tɨɨtɨs; mi' dhɨr xoi'kam tu' gu vupui tu' bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan dhaibu' ka't jix duñia' gu vaak na jix bhai' vupui bhaan bhaan.

Jano' ba' jix kai gu ñi'ook chu'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' bɨɨx gu chio'ñ jix bɨɨx duu gu ja'tkam kua'dam gu Sabeos oidha' jix gaki; mi' dhɨr jix dhaas bhaan gu noobh gu jodai' na jix uam gɇ'kamtu'nda' bhaan ɨɨbhidham.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia'; gio ba' jano' bɨɨx.
Na gu' na gu' jix duñia' tɨbiap na ja'p jupaabkamu'n gu u'vɨ ganai'; gio ba' tɨɨtɨs gu Aola gu Aoliba gu u'vɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chichio'ñ jir bhai' ja'tkam gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu ɨ'ɨr; na gu' gu ɨ'ɨr cham tu'x jai'ch gu noobh.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' jix tɨ'ɨ bhaan kapbhai'.
Jano' ba' chu'p chɨbɨɨp gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu jodai bɨɨx u'uux; gio ba' yaa' gu ma'nkam ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu vaak bɨɨx gu tai.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' bɨx gu u'vɨ cham jix duu bhaan gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim.
Jano' ba' bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' uañi'ñ duiñxim; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' ka't tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix bhai'x oi'ñga' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook mambhɨɨx bham.
Jano' ba' gu mar gu chio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tɨɨgɨ' dhi' gu tanoolh; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia jix dhaas bhaan gu Jerusalem dhi' gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu vaak uañi'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ua'rgidhak; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gio gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' bɨx jix bhai' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr o'oo.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ kaneer gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gio jix duñia' o'oo bɨtaa'n; mi' dhɨr gu vupui xoi'kam; jano' ba' gio o'oo gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu ñi'ook kiicham gu ɨ'ɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham jix buus gu Por; mi' dhɨr cham jix duñia' bhaan.
Na gu' na gu' gu ɨ'ɨr ka't tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' bhaan gu jodai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix dhaas; mi' dhɨr cham ja'aa bhaan gu oidha' na ba' jum duu iiñat bɨɨx oo'.
Jano' ba' dhaibu gu ñi'ook jix tɨ'ɨ daak na ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ɨ'ɨr bhaan gu jodai na ba' cham ka't iiñat.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu ñi'ook kiicham gu ɨ'ɨr gio tu'.
Jano' ba' jix mui' gu u'u gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tai na ba' gu chuukug; gio ba' o'oo ka't.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mi' dhɨr bhaan na ba' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' cham jix buus; gio ba' gu tai ka't.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix maat; na gu' tu' cham tu'; mi' dhɨr cham pai' dhuuk tu' jix duñia' bɨɨx ka'm tu' gu ñi'ook daak bhaan tu'.

Jano' ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook; gio ba' ɨlhdham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr cham tu' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch tu'; jano' ba' bhaan gu bhóogɨt buimɨi tu' gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' ka't tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bham.
Jano' ba' gu mar gu chio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' koi'm gu ñi'ook gu vupui; gio ba' cham tu' gu ñi'ook tu' suakɨt.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham; gio ba' o'o bhaan tu' jix dhaas tɨɨt cham tu' bɨɨx tu' jugi gu takarui' gu chichio'ñ.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu xibh gu xumai jix koi gu u'vɨ; gio ba' gu xibh na ja'p ka't jix duñia'.
Ba' jix aa' gu ja'tkam; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook dhi' tu'x tu' bhaan.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu' bham.

Jano' ba' tu' gu vaak gu Israeel; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu Miren tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xidhuu gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu kavɨk gu ñi'ook gu vupui gu i'ii'ñ; jano' ba' gu ma'nkam ma'nkam u'uuvɨ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu'; gio ba' cham bɨɨx tu' jugi gu takarui' gu chichio'ñ.
Jano' ba' o'o no'm bhaan ɨɨbhidham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨɨt; gio ba' cham tu' gu ñi'ook kuiñcha tu' na cham jir bhai' bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu Esekieel ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam nɨi'ñchudat; gio ba' bhaan bɨx tu'x jix duu; mi' dhɨr bai'ñpu' dhi' jano' ba' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' tu' gu mar gu chio'ñ gu tanoolh tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kavɨk gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu ñi'ook gu vupui gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ gu ma'nkam ma'nkam u'uuvɨ.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu tanoolh ɨlhdham tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba'.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook gu chin na ba' ñiokda' bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook cham dhi' jix bhai'x; gio ba' ka' nɨi'ñchudat tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' ka't tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bham.
Jano' ba' gu mar gu chio'ñ jix dhaas gu vupui bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon jix duñia' bhaan.

Jano' ba' daipu' gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' tu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook xidhuu ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu oidha' gu Israeel ka't bhaan gu vaak gu Judaa na gu' jix bɨɨx duu.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' kapbhai' gu Orientales gu maa'nkar jix duñia' tu' vaak zel; gio ba' jugi i'i bii'm.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Rabba ba'bhak jix ai gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon kakneer; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Na gu' na gu' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu noobh tu' gu i'ii'ñ bɨx bhaan gu oidha' gu Israeel.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu novɨ bhaan tu' kapbhai' chɨbɨɨp na ba'; gio ba' tu' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam tu' tɨjɨɨ'ñ oi'ñga'n; mi' dhɨr tu'; jano' ba' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' jix aa' gu Moab gu Seir; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu Judaa na ja'p bɨx chɨbɨɨp.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ñi'ook gu Moab dɨr jɨ'dɨlh dɨr jɨ'dɨlh oi'ñga'n gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu Bet-jesimot gu Baal-meoon gu Kîriataim.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam tas buusñi bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon; gio ba' kapbhai' gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar na ba' cham ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chɨ'ñchoka' gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon tɨjɨɨ'ñ chɨbɨɨp.
Jano' ba' gio gu Moab gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñi'ook na jir bhai'; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix duu gu Edom dhaagɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu Judaa.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' gio gu novɨ bhaan gu Edom gu chichio'ñ gu vaakax; mi' dhɨr dɨr gu Temaan gu Dedaan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Edom gu novɨ gu ja'tkam gu Israeel; gio ba' jix duu gu Edom bhaan daak; mi' dhɨr jix maati' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook jix duu gu Palestinos bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na pai' dhuuk bɨɨx jix duñia' gu ñi'ook.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Miren tu' gu ñi'ook gu novɨ bhaan gu Palestinos gu Kereteos gu gɨ' suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx daak; na pai' dhuuk tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios na pai' dhuuk.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oi'ñga' maa'n ka't tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bham.

Ba' jix aa' gu mar gu chio'ñ na gu' gu Tiro bhaan gu Jerusalem; gio ba' tu' xoi'kam; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't ki'ñgob gu ja'tkam; jano' ba' tu'; gio ba' jix duñia' jix bhuup; mi' dhɨr oidha' jix gaki.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' bhaan tu' gu ñi'ook gu Tiro jix tɨ'ɨ bhaan tu' mumua'da' chɨbɨɨp na ja'p gu gɨ' suudai' jix tɨ'ɨ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaak jodai gu Tiro jix duñia' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' oo' na ja'p gu jodai' na jix uam.
Na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam a'sak ka't tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu gɨ' suudai' na gu' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' ka't chɨbɨɨp.
Jano' ba' ma'nkam u'uuvɨ yooxi' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Na gu' na gu' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' bhaan gu Tiro gu Nabukodonosor gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia gu gɨ'kora' bɨɨx kavaayo jix jai' gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' ma'nkam u'uuvɨ yooxi' mu'aa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' bhaan tu' bhaan tu' bhaan tu' kutun kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan vaak jodai gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kavaayo tu' gu ñi'ook oo'; na pai' dhuuk bɨɨx kavaayo vaak jodai na pai' dhuuk ba'k kiki'ñgob na ja'p kiicham.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kavaayo bɨx; gio ba' gu ja'tkam mu'aa dhi' gu kavɨk gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam namkɨm jix duñia'; gio ba' vaak jodai gu vaak a'bhar; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu jodai gu u'u oo' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p gu jodai' na jix uam; gio ba' a'sak ka'; mi' dhɨr tu' cham pai' dhuuk ka'; na gu' tu' gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu Tiro; na pai' dhuuk cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' bɨx chiñia' gu gɨ' suudai' jix dhaav a'toxkar gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook kutun jix duñia' bhaan gu oidha' no'm bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook bhaan tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' gu gɨ' suudai' kiicham ka't jix kavɨk gu gɨ' suudai' gu ñi'ook bɨx gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' jano' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh gu gɨ' suudai'.

Na gu' na gu' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kiicham na ja'p jɨ'dɨlh cham; mi' dhɨr jix tɨ'ɨ bhaan tu' jix dhaam suudai' mumua'da' gu suudai' tu' gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix dhaav bɨɨx tukga'n bɨɨx gu ja'tkam; gio ba' tu' gu ñi'ook gu oidha' na ja'p oidha' jix gaki bɨɨx tukga'n na ba' cham pai' dhuuk; mi' dhɨr tu' gɇ'kamtu'nda' pai' na jix do'ig.
Jano' ba' gu Yo tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook cham ka'; gio ba' ka' cham pai' dhuuk ka' bakia' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' ka't tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bham.
Jano' ba' tu' gu mar gu chio'ñ gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu Tiro.

Jano' ba' daipu' gu Tiro gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ba'k gu gɨ' suudai' gu ja'tkam mumua'da'; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu Tiro tu' tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' gu Yo jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu i'ii'ñ gu gɨ' suudai' gu ñi'ook; na tu' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gɨ'x bhai'.
Jano' ba' cham tu'x jai'ch gu kavɨk gu Senir tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ gɨ' u'u kavɨk gu Liibano na ba'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Basaan jix duu; gio ba' chu'p gu Asirios jix duu gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu Kittim.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Ejipto ka't gu ñi'ook na ba' tu' jix duñia'; gio ba' gu Elisa ka't gu vaak na jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu Sidoon gu Arbad jix bɨɨx duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' mamatdagɨm gu ñi'ook gu Tiro mi'p tu'; mi' dhɨr jix bɨɨx duu.
Jano' ba' daraa gu Gebal mamatdagɨm gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' bɨx gu gɨ' suudai' jix bɨɨx duu tu' na ba'.
Jano' ba' gu Persas gu Lidios gu Put jix bɨɨx duu ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu chichio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' tu'; mi' dhɨr tu' jix maa nɨidhat.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Arbad bɨɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan vaak jodai xikoolh gu Gammadeos gu ñi'ook; gio ba' kutun kavɨk jix duñia' bhaan vaak jodai xikoolh; mi' dhɨr jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu Tarsis gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kuiñcha bɨx namkɨm jix toja jodai jix kavɨk jodai dhi' jix maa.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Tubal gu Mesek bɨɨx gu chichio'ñ bɨɨx gu jodai' na jix uam jix maa.
Jano' ba' gu vaak gu Togarma kavaayo gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix maa.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Dedaan jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' mumua'da' gu novɨ; mi' dhɨr a'aa' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim tu' jix maa.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' bɨɨx ñakaabma' jajannulhi'ñ gu ñi'ook jix maa.
Jano' ba' gu Judaa gu oidha' gu Israeel jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu Minit gu ñi'ook bɨ'ñdhatu' gu jodai' na jix uam jix maa.
Jano' ba' gu Damasko gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bɨx namkɨm bɨɨx suudai' u'va gu elboon.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dan gu Jabaan jix maa na ba' jix kavɨk jodai gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Dedaan ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx na ba'.
