Jano' ba' gu Arabia bɨx chiñia' gu Kedar jix duñia' gu novɨ ali' karneer gu chuukug gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ɨ'ɨɨr; gio ba' dhi' tu'x jix bɨɨx duu jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Seba gu Raama jix bɨɨx duu; gio ba' bɨɨx gɨ'kora' ja'tkam bɨx gu jodai dha'ram jix uam jodai jix maa.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Kanne gu Edeen gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Seba gu Asiria gu Kilmad bɨndak.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨndak tu'x; gio ba' jodai na jix tuk a'bhar bɨɨx gu u'u gɨ' u'u kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Tarsis jix bɨɨx duu; gio ba' jix bhuup jix duñia' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu gɨ' suudai'.
Jano' ba' mumua'da' gu suudai' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu jɨvɨl tu' jix duñia' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu gɨ' suudai'.
Jano' ba' namkɨm gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu chichio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham cham tu'x jai'ch tu' bɨɨx bɨx chu'p tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' bakia' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu gɨ' suudai' gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jiiñak gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim.
Jano' ba' jix dhaav gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx; gio ba' bɨx gu gɨ' suudai' gu ñi'ook gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bhaan tu' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim oo' bhaan ɨɨbhidham jix duñia' maatai.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tu jiim tu' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim bɨɨx gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook bhaan tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan tu' bham; gio ba' chɨkka na ja'p gu Tiro na ja'p tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu gɨ' suudai'.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix buus mui'x gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu oidha' bɨɨx namkɨm.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook ka' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ' suudai' gu suudai' jugi bɨx chu'p tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim bhaan tu' gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu vupui.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ja'tkam jix duñia' bhaan tu'; gio ba' ɨlhdham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook kiicha' na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Jano' ba' ka't tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bham.

Jano' ba' gu mar gu chio'ñ tu' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu Tiro; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' gu Yo jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios dhi' daakat tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu gɨ' suudai' tu' gu chio'ñ cham gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ na ja'p gu i'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix bhai'x gu Danieel; gio ba' cham cham tu'x jai'ch ɨxchuixim tu' ka't.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx matda' bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ñi'ook namkɨm jix uam jodai jix toja jodai.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam matda' namkɨm; gio ba' kuiñcha namkɨm tu' gu i'ii'ñ.
Na ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' gu i'ii'ñ na ja'p gu i'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' bhaan tu' jix kavɨk chɨbɨɨp u'uux bhaan matda'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix duu jix dhaav koi kuusdaidha' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu gɨ' suudai'.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bham; gio ba' gu Yo jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu chio'ñ cham gu Jawatan Dios gu novɨ.
Jano' ba' koi'm gu ñi'ook koi gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ; na gu' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' ka't tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bham.
Jano' ba' gu mar gu chio'ñ gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu gɨ'kora' gu Tiro; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr tu' bhiibgixim jix bhuup matda' gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu Edeen u'uu pai' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' bɨx gu jodai dha'ram ka't kutun; mi' dhɨr jodai na jix vɨgɨ jodai na jix uam jodai na jix kavɨk jodai na jix tɨkɨr jodai na jix chɨdɨ jix uam jodai na ba' tu' gu tanoolh duñia'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu ñi'ook jix gɨ' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' tu'; mi' dhɨr jix bhaan gu kavɨk gu Jawatan Dios; jano' ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu jodai gu tai.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu bhóogɨt dɨr gu tanoolh jix duñia' bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook tu' tu' na cham jir bhai'.
Jano' ba' kuiñcha gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhuup tu' na cham jir bhai'; gio ba' tu' gu kavɨk gu Jawatan Dios tu' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu jodai gu tai gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ kuiñcha matda' kuiñcha; gio ba' tu' gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora' tu' na ba' tu'.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' na cham jir bhai' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook xidhuu; gio ba' tu' gu tai tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' maatai bhaan gu oidha' gu vupui bɨx tu'.
Jano' ba' bɨx tu' jix maati' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim bhaan tu'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook ka' na ba' bɨɨx tas kiicha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' ka't tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bham.
Jano' ba' gu mar gu chio'ñ jix dhaas gu vupui bhaan gu Sidoon jix duñia' bhaan.

Jano' ba' daipu'; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu Miren tu' bhaan tu' gu ñi'ook gu Sidoon tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' jix duñia' tas na jix gɨ'; na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' ñi'ook na jir bhai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu ɨ'ɨr; gio ba' koko'kam tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx gu kuchii bhaan xikoolh; mi' dhɨr tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' cham pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu vaak gu Israeel gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook jix maa jix duñia' bɨx xikoolh; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu Israeel gu ja'tkam tɨjɨɨ'ñ jano' ba' gu vupui chɨbɨɨp jix daa gu oidha' tu' tu duukam gu Jakob.
Na pai' dhuuk jix daa gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu ñi'ook oidha' u'va jix daa jix duñia' na pai' dhuuk tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñi'ook na jir bhai' bɨx xikoolh; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' oi'ñga' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook ka't tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bham.
Jano' ba' gu mar gu chio'ñ jix dhaas gu vupui bhaan gu Faraoon gu gɨ'kora' gu Ejipto jix duñia' bhaan bɨx gu Ejipto.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook tu'; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' bhaan tu' gu Faraoon gu gɨ'kora' gu Ejipto tɨrook tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix aa'; jano' ba' gɨ' suudai' jiim tu'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu vatop tu' jix buusñi tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx gu vatop.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oidha' jix gaki tu' bɨx gu vatop; gio ba' bhaan gu vupui yooxi'; mi' dhɨr cham ka' gu ñi'ook tu' ka' gu ñi'ook; jano' ba' gu vaakax gu oidha' gu u'uvhig gu tɨkɨr tu' jix maa jugi.
Na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu Ejipto tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios na gu' jix bɨɨx duu gu vaak gu Israeel.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu novɨ tu' bɨx; na pai' dhuuk bhaan tu' jix duñia'.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' bhaan tu' gu kuchii tu' gu chichio'ñ gu vaakax.
Jano' ba' gu oidha' gu Ejipto ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oidha' jix gaki; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' jix aa'; jano' ba' gɨ' suudai' jiim tu'.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' bhaan tu' bhaan; gio ba' gu oidha' gu Ejipto gu ñi'ook oidha' jix gaki dɨr gu Migdol bɨɨx ka'm gu Sebene bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook gu Etiopiia.
Jano' ba' cham gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨɨt gu chio'ñ tu' tɨɨt gu vaakax gu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' ka't oo'm.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' gu Ejipto tɨjɨɨ'ñ oi'ñga'n jɨ'dɨlh tɨjɨɨ'ñ jɨ'dɨlh no'm oo'm; gio ba' gu Ejipto tɨjɨɨ'ñ chɨbɨɨp gu ñi'ook oi'ñga'n.
Na gu' na gu' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu ñi'ook oo'm gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Ejipto gu ja'tkam tɨjɨɨ'ñ ua'tulhi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Ejipto gu oidha' gu Patros gu oidha' ba'bhak; gio ba' ka't oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' ka't; gio ba' tu' bhaan chɨbɨɨp; na gu' tu' na ba' cham chɨbɨɨp.
Jano' ba' cham ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu Israeel chotdonɨt uañi'ñ tɨɨgɨk; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' ka't oi'ñga' gu ñi'ook kɨɨv gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'n ka't tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bham.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu mar gu chio'ñ gu Nabukodonosor gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix gɨ' bhaan gu Tiro; gio ba' bɨx mo'o bɨx; mi' dhɨr tu' na ba' tu' na ba' ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham ka't gu Tiro bhaan.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' gu Nabukodonosor gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia gu oidha' gu Ejipto; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook na ba' ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu jiim bɨɨx bhaan jix maa gu oidha' gu Ejipto; na gu' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu Israeel tu' gu ñi'ook gu chin tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' ka't tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bham.
Jano' ba' gu mar gu chio'ñ jix duñia' tu'; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh.
Na gu' na gu' mia'n gu tanoolh mia'n gu tanoolh gu Jawatan; gio ba' gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh chɨbɨɨp ka't.
Na pai' dhuuk ɨlhdham gu kuchii gu Ejipto gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ɨɨbhi'ñ gu Etiopiia na pai' dhuuk gu Ejipto; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ ka't.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Libia gu Lidia bɨx gu ja'tkam gu Kûb gu ma'nkam gu oidha' bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gio gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Ejipto gu suudai' gu kavɨk; mi' dhɨr dɨr gu Migdol bɨɨx ka'm gu Sebene tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ oi'ñga'n jɨ'dɨlh ka't tɨjɨɨ'ñ jɨ'dɨlh oidha' jix gaki.
Na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios na pai' dhuuk gu tai gu Ejipto ua'tulhi'ñ bɨx.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan tu' gu Etiopiia jix duñia' gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu tanoolh gu Ejipto; na gu' jupaabkamu'n.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Ejipto gu novɨ gu Nabukodonosor gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix kavɨk chɨbɨɨp ka't cham tu' duu gu oidha'; gio ba' u'uux bhaan gu Ejipto gu oidha' koko'kam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kapbhai' gu oidha' gu noobh tomaat gu oidha' gu novɨ; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gio duiñxim gu Mempis; mi' dhɨr cham gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu oidha' gu Ejipto gu oidha' gu Ejipto choo'n.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Patros gu tai gu Soaan ñi'ook na jir bhai' cham.
Jano' ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim daak bhaan cham gu kavɨk gu Ejipto gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tai gu Ejipto; gio ba' cham ka't gu Mempis.
Jano' ba' biipibop gu Abeen gu Pibeset gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba'.
Na pai' dhuuk gu Teapnes ka't gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu Ejipto gu kavɨk; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n taañpu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñi'ook na jir bhai' gu Ejipto tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' ka't oi'ñga' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'n kɨɨv ka't tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bham.
Jano' ba' gu mar gu chio'ñ jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook gu Faraoon gu gɨ'kora' gu Ejipto; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook na ba' gu ñi'ook na ba' mambhɨɨx gu kuchii.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' bhaan gu Faraoon gu gɨ'kora' gu Ejipto jix kavɨk gu kuchii jix duñia' gu novɨ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Egipkios tɨjɨɨ'ñ chɨbɨɨp gu ñi'ook oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia gu kuchii gu novɨ; gu' gu Faraoon vupui bhaan tu jiim bɨɨx koi'm.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia gu Faraoon; na pai' dhuuk tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios na pai' dhuuk tu' gu kuchii gu novɨ gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia bhaan gu oidha' gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Egipkios tɨjɨɨ'ñ chɨbɨɨp gu ñi'ook oi'ñga'n; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' ka't oi'ñga' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaik maa'n ka't tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bham.
Jano' ba' gu mar gu chio'ñ tu' gu Faraoon gu gɨ'kora' gu Ejipto gu ja'tkam; gio ba' chɨkka tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu Asirio gɨ' u'u kavɨk gu Liibano gu ñi'ook mamraga'n bɨɨx gu ñi'ook jix gɨ' gu ñi'ook vaaso ka't tɨjɨɨ'ñ mamraga'n.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' jix duu gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix dhaam suudai'; gio ba' jix duñia' xikoolh tɨɨt bɨx gu u'u yooxi' gu ñi'ook.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bhaan bɨx gu u'u yooxi' jix mui' kuiñcha mumua'da' gu suudai' mamraga'n ka't baas.
Jano' ba' mamraga'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bɨx gu u'uvhig gu tɨkɨr bɨtaa'n gu ñi'ook bɨx gu vaakax yooxi' ɨkgiga'n oi'ñka' mumua'da' chɨbɨɨp.
Jano' ba' jix duu jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx mamraga'n; na gu' tatk ka't ju'ñdharan mumua'da' gu suudai'.

Jano' ba' gɨ' u'u kavɨk cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam u'uu pai' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham tu'x jai'ch cham jix bɨɨx duu tuutu'm mamraga'n tu' jix bɨɨx duu tuutu'm; mi' dhɨr gu u'u u'uu pai' gu Jawatan Dios ka't nɨidhim.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bɨɨx mamraga'n; gio ba' bɨx gu u'u gu Edeen mi'p u'uu pai' gu Jawatan Dios chooto'n jɨɨgak.
Ba' jix aa' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' tu' gu ñi'ook jix dhaas tɨjɨɨ'ñ mamraga'n gu i'ii'ñ jix duñia' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' kapbhai' gu novɨ jix kavɨk chɨbɨɨp tɨɨda' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix kavɨk chɨbɨɨp jix duñia'; gio ba' mamraga'n bhaan gu kakkavɨk bɨx gu oidha' ka't; mi' dhɨr tu' tu jiim ɨkgiga'n bɨx gu ja'tkam gu oidha' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu u'uvhig gu tɨkɨr bhaan mamraga'n no'm bɨx gu vaakax yooxi'.

Na ba' na ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu u'u bɨx gu suudai' tu' tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' mamraga'n gu ñi'ook bɨx gu suudai'; na gu' bɨx ka't kapbhai' koi'm gu oidha' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu chichio'ñ bɨɨx.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tanoolh jix dhaav gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jix dhaam suudai' mumua'da' gu suudai' jix bɨɨx duu; mi' dhɨr gu Liibano gu tukgam bɨx gu u'u yooxi'.
Na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chɨbɨɨp na pai' dhuuk jix dhaav bɨɨx bɨx; gio ba' bɨx gu u'u gu Edeen tutkɨ gu Liibano bɨx gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gio jix dhaav bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx koko'kam jix bɨɨx duu gu ñi'ook ɨkgiga'n tɨjɨɨ'ñ chɨbɨɨp.

Jano' ba' chɨkka tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gɇ'kamtu'nda' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu u'u gu Edeen ka' bɨɨx gu u'u gu Edeen gu oidha'; gio ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook bɨɨx koko'kam; mi' dhɨr dhi' gu Faraoon bɨx gu ja'tkam tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' ka't oi'ñga' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook maa'n ka't tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bham.

Jano' ba' gu mar gu chio'ñ gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu Faraoon gu gɨ'kora' gu Ejipto; gio ba' chɨbɨɨp nɨidhim na ja'p gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu gɨ' suudai'; na gu suudai' bɨɨx tɨɨt.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan tu' jix vɨgɨ bɨɨx gu masad mui'x gu ja'tkam tu' jix duu jix tɨ'ɨ bɨɨx gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' tu' bhaan gu vupui yooxi' bhaan tu' bɨx gu u'uvhig gu tɨkɨr tu' gu vaakax bɨx gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chuukug bhaan gu kakkavɨk jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ɨ'ɨr gu oidha' pai' bɨɨx ka'm gu kakkavɨk; gio ba' tu'.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix koi gu tɨkɨr gu si'avag; gio ba' gu tas bɨɨx gu masad cham gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu tasi'.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu tasi' tɨkɨr gu tasi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tɨkɨr tu' gu tukgam bhaan gu oidha' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ mui'x gu ja'tkam na pai' dhuuk bhaan chɨbɨɨp oi'ñga'n cham.

Na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan tu' mui'x gu ja'tkam gu gɨ'kora' jix duñia' kuiñcha tu' jix gɨ' na pai' dhuuk gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu kuchii vupui bhaan gu vupui; gio ba' bɨx daam gu tanoolh.
Na gu' na gu' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu kuchii gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia ɨlhdham bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx u'uux jix kavɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam; gio ba' bɨx ka't jix kavɨk chɨbɨɨp; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Ejipto bɨx ka't.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu vaakax gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan mumua'da' gu suudai'; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' tɨɨt gu chio'ñ tu' gu ñi'ook gu vaakax jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu suudai' tu' na ja'p bɨ'ñdhatu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' gu Ejipto gu oidha' ua'tulhi'ñ na pai' dhuuk bɨx gu ñi'ook tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xoi'kam jix duñia'; gio ba' ma'nkam u'uuvɨ chɨbɨɨp; mi' dhɨr bhaan gu Ejipto bhaan bɨx tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' ka't oi'ñga' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bham.
Jano' ba' gu mar gu chio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu Ejipto chɨbɨɨp jix kavɨk gu oidha' bɨɨx.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jix duñia' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ koko'kam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' dhagia'; mi' dhɨr bɨx gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook jix kavɨk bɨɨx jix dhaav bɨɨx gu ñi'ook koko'kam.
Jano' ba' gu Assur bɨɨx bɨx gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam pai'm; mi' dhɨr bɨx ia'rɨ koko'kam.
Jano' ba' pai'm jix bɨɨx duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam xikoolh tukga'n; gio ba' bɨx ia'rɨ koko'kam jix dhaas ɨɨbhi'ñ gu oidha' na jix do'ig.

Jano' ba' gu Elam bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xikoolh tukga'n; na gu' bɨx ia'rɨ koko'kam jix dhaav gu ñi'ook gu oidha' na gu' jix dhaas gu ñi'ook gu oidha' na jix do'ig gu' bhɨɨk gu jodai' na jix uam bɨɨx tukga'n.

Jano' ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ koko'kam jix dhaas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx bɨx; gio ba' xikoolh pai'm; na gu' bɨx gu ñi'ook koko'kam na gu' ka't gu ñi'ook gu oidha' na jix do'ig gu' bhɨɨk gu jodai' na jix uam bɨɨx tukga'n; jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ koko'kam.
Jano' ba' gu Mesek gu Tubal bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' pai'm xikoolh; na gu' bɨx gu ñi'ook koko'kam na gu' jix maa gu ñi'ook gu oidha' na jix do'ig.

Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx jix kavɨk ia'rɨ gu ñi'ook jix dhaav tukga'n bɨɨx gu ñi'ook bhɨɨ'ñdham jix dhaas u'uux bɨtaa'n ɨɨbhidham; na gu' gu' uañi'ñ no'm bhaan o'oo na gu' jix bɨɨx duu gu ñi'ook jix kavɨk gu oidha' na jix do'ig.
Jano' ba' tu' ka' jix bhai'x tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx koko'kam.
Jano' ba' gu Idumea gu gɨ'kora' bɨx chiñia' bɨɨx gu kavɨk jix bɨɨx duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx koko'kam; gio ba' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook bɨɨx tukga'n.

Jano' ba' chiñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu Sidoon bɨɨx gu ñi'ook jix dhaav bɨɨx koko'kam gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu kavɨk gio gu ñi'ook bɨɨx koko'kam bhɨɨk gu jodai' na jix uam bɨɨx tukga'n.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Faraoon bhaan bɨx; gio ba' gu Faraoon jix koi bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Na gu' na gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu oidha' na jix do'ig gio tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook bɨɨx koko'kam gu Faraoon bɨx tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' ka't tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bham.

Jano' ba' gu mar gu chio'ñ tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' tu' gu kuchii bhaan gu oidha' gu ja'tkam gu oidha' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu chio'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' jix ai gu kuchii bhaan gu oidha' kuichdha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' no'x jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham bai'ñpu' gu kuchii gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu ɨ'ɨr ka't bhaan mo'o.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix kai cham; gio ba' gu ɨ'ɨr ka't bhaan; gu' gu oidha'.

Gu' gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' jix ai gu kuchii cham kuichdha' gu ja'tkam cham bai'ñpu' gu kuchii gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim oi'ñdha'; gio ba' kuiñcha uañi'ñ ka't jix duñia' gu' gu ɨ'ɨr gu novɨ.
Jano' ba' tu' gu mar gu chio'ñ tu' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu Israeel gu ñi'ook gu chin baasɨ'n.
Jano' ba' bham tu' jix bhai'x; gio ba' jix bhai'x tɨɨda' koi; mi' dhɨr tu' cham ñiokda' na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x gu bhóogɨt jix bhai'x koi uañi'ñ gu' gu ɨ'ɨr tu' gu novɨ.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x gu bhóogɨt na ba' dɨlhkob cham gu bhóogɨt uañi'ñ koi tu' gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu mar gu chio'ñ tu' gu vaak gu Israeel; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' tu ñi'ook bham; mi' dhɨr uañi'ñ bhaan no'ch kuiñcha gu'ch; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook duaka'.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios cham gu ñi'ook koi'm jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x gu bhóogɨt gu tai; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook tomaat gu bhóogɨt; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook koi gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' tu' gu mar gu chio'ñ tu' gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam; gio ba' bɨx bhai' jir bhai' cham jix duñia' gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr jix bhai'x cham ka't dhi' gu tanoolh; jano' ba' jir bhai' cham duaka' bɨx bhai' gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' jix duu bham tu' jir bhai' tɨɨda' ii'mdagaram gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx bhai' jix duñia' tu' na cham jir bhai' bɨx bɨx bhai' cham aajim chɨ'ñchoka' gu ñi'ook koi tu' na cham jir bhai'.
Jano' ba' bham tu' jix bhai'x; gio ba' tɨɨda' koi; mi' dhɨr tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam uañi'ñ tu' jix duñia' ñi'ook na jir bhai' bɨx bhai'.
Jano' ba' tu' jix bhai'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhɨɨya' gu oidha' cham gu ñi'ook tu' na cham jir bhai' ii'mdagaram gu ñi'ook cham koi.
Jano' ba' cham gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam uañi'ñ ka't; gio ba' jix duu ñi'ook na jir bhai' bɨx bhai'; mi' dhɨr ii'mdagaram gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam; gio ba' cham gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan; mi' dhɨr gu bhóogɨt cham.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk jir bhai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx bhai' tu' jix duñia' tu' na cham jir bhai' koi.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk jix bhai'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix duñia' ñi'ook na jir bhai' bɨx bhai' ii'mdagaram.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan; mi' dhɨr tu' gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Israeel maa'n jurtu'nka' gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' ka't oi'ñga' gu ñi'ook chulhiiñdha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jixchamaam suudai' u'va tu' gu Jerusalem bham; gio ba' kiicham tu' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu novɨ gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duñia' bhaan tu' gu xumai va'k gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't jix kupi'ook gu chin bɨɨx ka'm suudai' u'va tu' gu xibh; gio ba' jix kupi'ook gu chin cham.
Jano' ba' ka't tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bham.

Jano' ba' gu mar gu chio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mii' dhɨr ja'tkam oidha' jix gaki gu oidha' gu Israeel a'gi'ñchu' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu Abraam ka't maa'n pai'; na gu' no'ch gu'ch mui'x; jano' ba' no'ch pai' gu maa'nkar.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr bɨɨx gu ɨ'ɨr jugi duiñxim gu vupui gu ɨ'ɨr gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim bia'ka' gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan u'uux gu u'vɨ tɨtmo; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' daipu'; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook tu' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu vupui yooxi' kapbhai' gu vaakax; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook koi.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' oidha' jix gaki gu kavɨk; gio ba' gu kakkavɨk gu Israeel ka't cham ka't.
Na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios na pai' dhuuk gu oidha' oidha' jix gaki bɨx jix duñia' gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' tu' gu mar gu chio'ñ gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' ju'ñdharan kiki'ñgob gu vaak tu ñi'ook maa'n bɨɨx maa'n bɨɨx xibhɨk bham; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jano' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' aajim tu' na ja'p jupaabkamu'n gu ja'tkam no'm vupui bhaan tu' na ja'p gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook cham jix duñia' tu duukam; gio ba' va'k xoi'kam bɨɨx gu chin gu i'ii'ñ jiim.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' na ja'p xoi'kam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu' cham jix duñia' tu duukam.
Na pai' dhuuk cham gu ñi'ook na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam daraibu' jupaabkamu'n ka't jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' ka't tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bham.

Jano' ba' gu mar gu chio'ñ jix duñia' bhaan bipia'dam gu Israeel; gio ba' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bipia'dam; mi' dhɨr tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook bipia'dam gu Israeel cham bipia'dam kakneer.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bii'm; gio ba' gu ñi'ook cham kakneer.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix duñia'; gio ba' cham tu' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n; gu' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam uañi'ñ bipia'dam; gio ba' jix bɨɨx duu na ba' gu ñi'ook bɨx gu vaakax yooxi' jix bɨɨx duu.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kakneer bɨx gu kakkavɨk bɨx jix bhai'x; gio ba' bɨx gu vupui gu oidha' jix bɨɨx duu kakneer cham ka't gu ñi'ook tu'.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bipia'dam jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Na gu' gu ñi'ook tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios na gu' kakneer ka't na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kakneer jix bɨɨx duu na ba' gu ñi'ook bɨx gu vaakax yooxi' cham bipia'dam; gio ba' tu' bipia'dam kakneer gu ñi'ook bipia'dam cham kakneer.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bipia'dam jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Miren tu' bipia'dam; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kakneer gu novɨ kakneer; jano' ba' tu' bipia'dam; na gu' tu' kakneer gu chin cham ka't jugi.
Na gu' na gu' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Miren tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kakneer.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kakneer bipia'dam gu tanoolh tɨjɨɨ'ñ kakneer bɨx pai' jix bɨɨx duu gu tanoolh gu tukgam.
Jano' ba' tu' jix buusñi gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oi'ñga'n; gio ba' gu oidha' gu kakkavɨk gu Israeel bɨx.
Jano' ba' jix bhai' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kakkavɨk gu Israeel ka't; gio ba' jix bhai' jix duñia' ka't bhaan gu kakkavɨk gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kakneer tu' mambhɨɨx tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n jix duñia'; gu' gu ñi'ook jix kavɨk; mi' dhɨr tu' ñi'ook na jir bhai'.
Gu' gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kakneer tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Miren tu' tɨjɨɨ'ñ kaneer tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chuukug kaneer ɨ'ɨɨr.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx tɨɨt jix duñia' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' i'i gu suudai' bɨɨx tɨɨt.
Jano' ba' kakneer kua'da' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨɨt bɨɨx tɨɨt jix duñia'.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Miren tu' tɨjɨɨ'ñ kaneer gu ñi'ook kaneer.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu ñi'ook bɨɨx a'aa' bɨx bɨɨx ka'm mai'.
Jano' ba' tu' dodhia' kakneer cham pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't; gio ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ kaneer.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan bipia'dam; gio ba' tu duukam gu Dabii; mi' dhɨr ka't bipia'dam.
Jano' ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios tu duukam gu Dabii gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' dhi' bɨɨx ñi'ook na jix bhaan bhai'x i'ii'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' gu vaakax; gio ba' jix daa oidha' jix gaki koox.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xikoolh gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix dhaav dhuuk gu ñi'ook ka't.
Jano' ba' gu u'u yooxi' maa'n gu i'bhɨ gu oidha' maa'n gu i'bhɨ no'm bhaan gu oidha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na pai' dhuuk tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios na pai' dhuuk gu novɨ tu jiim.
Jano' ba' cham ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chɨbɨɨp tu' gu vaakax gu oidha'; gu' gu ñi'ook jix daa cham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaas gu tɨɨgɨ' cham ka't bhiogi' gu oidha' tu' ka't gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a chɨbɨɨp.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' bɨɨx gu ja'tkam gu vaak gu Israeel tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kakneer gu chichio'ñ tu' gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' ka't tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bham.
Jano' ba' gu mar gu chio'ñ jix dhaas gu vupui bhaan gu kavɨk gu Seir jix duñia' bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu Miren tu' bhaan tu' gu ñi'ook gu kavɨk gu Seir gu novɨ bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' jɨ'dɨlh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' ka' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu kuchii gu ñi'ook cham bhai'.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu ɨ'ɨr tu' gu ɨ'ɨr tu' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ɨ'ɨr cham gu ɨ'ɨr tu' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kavɨk gu Seir.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kakkavɨk koko'kam; gio ba' bɨx koko'kam.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jɨ'dɨlh cham pai' dhuuk; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Na gu' na gu' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gook gu ja'tkam gook oi'ñga'n ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bia'ka' kua' gu Jawatan Dios.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios tu' jurtu'nka' daak jurtu'nka' bɨɨx kuiñcha bɨɨx; na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' na pai' dhuuk tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu Jawatan Dios naak bɨx bhaan gu kakkavɨk gu Israeel bham; gio ba'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan tu' bɨɨx gu chin bhaan tu' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu Yo tu'.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu oidha' tu'.
Na gu' na ja'p tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu maa'nkar gu vaak gu Israeel na gu' ka't tu'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook ka't gu kavɨk gu Seir bɨx gu Idumea bɨx; mi' dhɨr tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' tu' gu mar gu chio'ñ jix duñia' bhaan gu kakkavɨk gu Israeel tu'; gio ba' gu kakkavɨk gu Israeel jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' bhaamki'ñdha' jix aa' bhaan gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr tu' gio gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu'; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' na ba' gu maa'nkar chɨbɨɨp tu' gu ñi'ook gu chin ñiiñio'k gu ja'tkam.

Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kakkavɨk gu Israeel jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu kakkavɨk gu ñi'ook jɨ'dɨlh jix bɨɨx duu chɨbɨɨp xikoolh.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook tɨɨda' gu tai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan chɨbɨɨp bhaan bɨx gu Idumea gu oidha' gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar bɨɨx bhai' ñi'ook bɨx gu i'ii'ñ bɨɨx na ba' bhaai'n.

Na ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' bhaan gu oidha' gu Israeel tu' gu kakkavɨk; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' gu Miren i'iich tu ñi'ook na gu' jix duñia' baabuk chɨbɨɨp.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' gu novɨ chɨbɨɨp xikoolh jix duñia'.
Gu' gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu kakkavɨk gu Israeel gu i'bhɨ gu ja'tkam gu Israeel; na gu' mia'n na ba' jix ai.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan boopoya' ko'iim.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix mui' bhaan gu ñi'ook gu chichio'ñ bɨx gu vaak gu Israeel bɨx; gio ba' jɨ'dɨlh jix duñia' ka't.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu ñi'ook gu chichio'ñ gu vaakax ka't; gio ba' na ja'p gu ñi'ook gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jiim gu chichio'ñ bhaan gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam gu Israeel; gio ba' tu' gu ñi'ook ka' gu maa'nkar cham pai' dhuuk koo'nda' gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chichio'ñ gu ma'nkam chɨbɨɨp jix duñia'.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham gu chichio'ñ cham pai' dhuuk koo'nda' gu ma'nkam chɨbɨɨp tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' cham pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix duñia' chɨbɨɨp tu' gu ja'tkam tu' jix duu koi gu ma'nkam chɨbɨɨp tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' ka't tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bham.
Jano' ba' gu mar gu chio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' gu vaak gu Israeel bɨɨx gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx buimɨi; gio ba' na ja'p ka't gu bhóogɨt vupui bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam daak bhaan gu ɨ'ɨr gu ñi'ook bhaan gu oidha'; na gu' bɨɨx duiñxim.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chɨbɨɨp jix bɨɨx duu gu ñi'ook oi'ñga'n; gio ba' jurtu'nka' gu bhóogɨt jurtu'nka' buimɨi.
Jano' ba' ba'k chɨbɨɨp pai' jix bɨɨx duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhaan gu tɨɨgɨ' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu ja'tkam gu Jawatan Dios gu oidha' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhaan gu tɨɨgɨ' gu vaak gu Israeel tɨjɨɨ'ñ chɨbɨɨp pai' jix bɨɨx duu.

Na ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu vaak gu Israeel; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr cham gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Israeel gu ñi'ook kuiñcha jix bhaan gu tɨɨgɨ' gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ chɨbɨɨp pai' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix gɨ' gu tɨɨgɨ' tɨjɨɨ'ñ chɨbɨɨp gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ; na pai' dhuuk chɨbɨɨp tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios na pai' dhuuk ua'tulhi'ñ gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu vupui.
Jano' ba' tu' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim chɨbɨɨp gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu ñi'ook gu suudai' na jix bhai' boopoya' jix duñia' bɨx; gio ba' bɨx duiñxim.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ jix vɨɨk gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ jix vɨɨk gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu chuukug gu i'ii'ñ gu jodai gu i'ii'ñ gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook tu duukam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' tu' tattat; gio ba' gu ñi'ook boopoya' gu ja'tkam tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx; gio ba' mɨmɨim tiriik cham bhiogi'.
Na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'bhɨ gu u'u gu i'bhɨ vaak ja'tkam na gu' cham pai' dhuuk bhiogi' tɨjɨɨ'ñ chɨbɨɨp.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tomaat gu bhóogɨt buimɨi cham jix bɨɨx duu jix bhai'; gio ba' gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' na cham jir bhai' gu vaak gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu ñi'ook gio jix daa jɨ'dɨlh ka't.
Jano' ba' gu oidha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim pai' jix duñia' gu vupui bɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gui'p; gio ba' dhi' gu oidha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't na ja'p u'uu pai' gu Edeen; mi' dhɨr dhi' jɨ'dɨlh oidha' jix gaki gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' chɨbɨɨp jix bɨɨx duu tɨtda:―Cha'pim xikoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ux vaas na mi' oi'ñga'n; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu vaak gu Israeel na ba' duñia' dhi'; mi' dhɨr gu chichio'ñ kakneer.

Jano' ba' na ja'p kakneer jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' na ja'p kakneer gu Jerusalem gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jɨ'dɨlh oidha' jix gaki ka't jix bhuup kakneer gu chichio'ñ; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu novɨ gu Jawatan Dios ka't bhaan tu' jix buusñi gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jix dhaas tɨjɨɨ'ñ yooxi' ka't jix bhuup o'oo.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu ñi'ook mia'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx xikoolh; gio ba' jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt mui'x bhaan gu vupui yooxi' tɨɨda' jix gaki.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu mar gu chio'ñ gu ñi'ook dhi' ja'tkam o'oo tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios tu' ñɨidhat.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba'; gio ba' gu Propetisa bhaan dhi' ja'tkam o'oo gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr o'oo jix gaki jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios dhi' ja'tkam o'oo; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' baakɨi gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook duaka'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu ñi'ook jix tɨ'ɨ bhaan gu ñi'ook gu chuukug zel gu ñi'ook gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ duaka'; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p ka't jix duñia'; gio ba' ka't tɨroon tu' jix duñia' gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' o'oo o'o.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu chuukug jix tɨ'ɨ zel jix bhaan dhaas tu jiim; gu' cham ka't gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu Propetisa gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ jix duñia' gu mar gu chio'ñ tu' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ; mi' dhɨr tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; jano' ba' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ jix ai maakobh jɨbɨɨlh gu ñi'ook bhaan dhi' ja'tkam koko'kam na jix do'ig.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p ka't jix duñia' chɨbiapui gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ na jix do'ig bhaan tɨɨt ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham jix gɨ'.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu mar gu chio'ñ bɨx dhi' ja'tkam o'oo gu vaak gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' o'o o'oo nɨɨra gu'ch bɨx.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia'; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu Miren tu' pai'm gu ja'tkam jix tɨ'ɨ gu oidha' gu Israeel.
Na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios na pai' dhuuk pai'm jix buusñi gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook duaka' gu ñi'ook bhaan gu oidha'; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' ka't tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bham.

Jano' ba' tu' gu mar gu chio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' ua'ñxidha'; gio ba' gu Judaa gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr jix bhɨɨ mi' dhɨr ua'ñxidha'; jano' ba' gu Josee gu Epraim bɨx gu vaak gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'n bɨɨx na ba' ka't maa'n ka't maa'n gu novɨ.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk tu' tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam bham; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tu' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu Miren tu' gu ñi'ook gu Josee gu novɨ gu Epraim bopxi'ñ gu Israeel bɨɨx gu Judaa ka't maa'n gu novɨ.
Jano' ba' kaapak bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam no'm gu novɨ vupui bhaan gu vupui.
Jano' ba' daipu'; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel tɨjɨɨ'ñ chɨbɨɨp jix bɨɨx duu gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam gu oidha' gu kakkavɨk gu Israeel; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' ka't bɨx gu gɨ'kora'; mi' dhɨr cham pai' dhuuk ka't gook gu ja'tkam tu' cham pai' dhuuk ka't gook oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx duiñxim bɨɨx bɨx; gio ba' dodhia' bɨx jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr ka't gu ja'tkam tu' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' tu duukam gu Dabii ka't gu gɨ'kora' bhaan bɨx ka't bipia'dam; gio ba' jiim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam nukadham jix duñia' tu duukam.
Jano' ba' jix daa gu oidha' tu' tu duukam gu Jakob jix daa tattat; gio ba' jix daa gu ma'nkam na ba' bɨɨx tas; mi' dhɨr tu duukam gu Dabii ka't gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx ñi'ook na jix bhaan bhai'x i'ii'ñ ñi'ook na jix bhaan ka't bɨɨx; gio ba' xidhuu tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chɨbɨɨp tu' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel kua' xidhuu tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Jano' ba' ka't tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bham.
Jano' ba' gu mar gu chio'ñ jix dhaas gu vupui bhaan gu Gog gu oidha' gu Magog gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Mesek gu Tubal jix duñia' bhaan.
Jano' ba' tu'; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ñi'ook gu Gog gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu Mesek gu Tubal.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix buusñi tu' bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham kavaayo jajannulhi'ñ bɨx jix gɨ' bɨɨx gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu ñi'ook ua'tulhdhidha' bɨx u'uux.
Jano' ba' gu Persia gu Etiopiia gu Libia bɨɨx; gio ba' bɨx bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu Gomer bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu vaak gu Togarma gu ñi'ook bɨx; mi' dhɨr gu ja'tkam mui'x bɨndak.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' bɨx tu' jix nukadham.

Jano' ba' mui'x gu tanoolh ka' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' ɨlhdham gu oidha' dodhia' gu kuchii mui'x gu ja'tkam gu kakkavɨk gu Israeel bɨɨx tas jix bɨɨx duu na ba' gu ñi'ook; gu' ka't jix buusñi gu ja'tkam bɨx jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' ɨlhdham na ja'p; gio ba' na ja'p na ba' gu ñi'ook gu oidha' ka' tu' bɨx mui'x gu ja'tkam bɨndak.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' ka't mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh jix tɨ'ɨ gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham bhai'.
Jano' ba' daipu'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu oidha' taañpu' tu jiim chɨbɨɨp jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr bɨx cham vaak jodai cham namki' tu' kiki'ñgob.
Na ba' na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' gu ñi'ook; na ba' gu novɨ bhaan oi'ñga'n oidha' jix gaki tu' bhaan gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook chɨbɨɨp duñia' jix duñia' gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu Seba gu Dedaan jix duñia' gu Tarsis bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu'; gio ba' tɨbiap na ba' gu ñi'ook na ba' jix toja jodai jix uam jodai na ba' gu ñi'ook na ba' gu ñi'ook.

Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu mar gu chio'ñ tu' gu Gog; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; na pai' dhuuk mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook na pai' dhuuk gu ja'tkam gu Israeel jix daa cham tu'.
Jano' ba' ɨlhdham pai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tu' mui'x gu ja'tkam bɨndak bɨx kavaayo jix gɨ' gu masad gu ñi'ook ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu ja'tkam gu Israeel na ja'p na ba' gu ñi'ook gu oidha'; gio ba' ka't gu tanoolh; na pai' dhuuk tu' bhaan gu oidha' na ba' chɨbɨɨp na pai' dhuuk ua'tulhi'ñ tu' gu ñi'ook gu Gog vupui bhaan gu vupui.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tu ñi'ook tu' tu duukam jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Israeel jix duñia' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam tu' ka't bhaan.
Ba' jix aa' ka't mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook na pai' dhuuk ɨlhdham gu Gog bhaan gu oidha' gu Israeel gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios jix tɨ'ɨ daak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Na gu' na gu' tu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tai daak; na mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' bhaan gu oidha' gu Israeel.

Na gu vatop gu gɨ' suudai' gu u'uvhig gu tɨkɨr gu vaakax yooxi' bɨx gu ko'oi gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ko'oi na oi'ñga'n chɨt tu jiim bhaan gu oidha' bɨx gu chichio'ñ bhaan gu vupui gu oidha'; gio ba' gu kakkavɨk pai' bhai' bɨx vaak jodai pai'.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu kakkavɨk mɨmɨim bhaan gu kuchii tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu kuchii ka't bhaan xibhɨk.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu ɨ'ɨr; gio ba' gu ñi'ook bhaan mui'x gu ja'tkam bɨɨx dhuuk gu jodai gu ñi'ook gu tai choiñ.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu vupui mumua'da' chɨbɨɨp; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu Tuu gu mar gu chio'ñ jix duñia' bhaan gu Gog tu'; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' bhaan tu' gu ñi'ook gu Gog gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu Mesek gu Tubal.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix tɨ'ɨ gu ñi'ook tu' bhaan gu kakkavɨk gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix buusñi gu ñi'ook gu novɨ o'nsop gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ tu jiim.
Jano' ba' bhaan gu kakkavɨk gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' bɨx gu ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu bɨndak; gio ba' bɨx gu u'uvhig bɨx da'a gu vaakax yooxi' tu' jix maa jugi.
Jano' ba' bhaan gu vupui yooxi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tai bhaan gu Magog bhaan gu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhaan gu tɨɨgɨ' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam gu Israeel cham pai' dhuuk jix bhaan gu tɨɨgɨ'; gio ba' chɨbɨɨp tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios jix bhaan gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam suudai' u'va ka't tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' dhi' gu tanoolh tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n jɨ'dɨlh gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu ñi'ook gu novɨ u'u kavɨk; gio ba' gu tai kɨɨv.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu u'u yooxi' tu' gu ñi'ook gu tai; gio ba' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' ka't mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Gog pai' na ba' gu Israeel tas buusñi gu gɨ' suudai' gu Gog bɨx; gio ba' tɨɨt gu amoon-gog.
Jano' ba' gu vaak gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook kɨɨv masaa'n na ba' gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' bɨx gu ja'tkam gu oidha'; gio ba' ka't na ba' gu tanoolh tu' ua'tulhi'ñ tas na jix gɨ' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chichio'ñ bɨɨx na ba' gu ñi'ook bhaan gu vupui gu oidha' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' kɨɨv masaa'n jix duu.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' o'oo gu chio'ñ gu ñi'ook ju'ñdharan bɨɨx ka'm gu amoon-gog.
Jano' ba' gio gu tɨɨgɨ' kiicham ka't gu amona; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' tu' gu mar gu chio'ñ tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' gu u'uvhig bɨx da'a bɨx gu vaakax yooxi'; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; jano' ba' bɨx maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan gu maa'nkar jix gɨ' bhaan gu kakkavɨk gu Israeel jugi gu chuukug i'i gu ɨ'ɨr.
Jano' ba' jugi gu chuukug jix kavɨk i'i gu ɨ'ɨr chiñia' gu oidha'; gio ba' gu chuukug ali' karneer gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chiiw gu vaakax tutuur bɨx gu Basaan.
Jano' ba' jugi gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx ka'm i'i bɨɨx ka'm gu ɨ'ɨr gu maa'nkar tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu vaak na jix bhai' kavaayo jix kavɨk bɨx gu chichio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gɇ'kamtu'nda' tɨjɨɨ'ñ chɨbɨɨp bɨx chɨbɨɨp ñi'ook na jir bhai' gu ñi'ook gu novɨ bhaan.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu Israeel tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chɨbɨɨp gu vaak gu Israeel ka't jix duñia' uañi'ñ; na gu' bhaan tu' gu vupui kapbhai' gu novɨ gu ñi'ook ia'rɨ bɨx.
Jano' ba' jurtu'nka' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jurtu'nka' bɨɨx; gio ba' gu vupui.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jano' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu Jakob xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch bɨx gu vaak gu Israeel jix bhaan gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xi'ɨraam bɨx uañi'ñ bɨɨx jix duñia' bhaan tu' na pai' dhuuk gu oidha' cham.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam oi'ñga'n obhɨɨ'ñ ua'tulhi'ñ gu vupui mumua'da' chɨbɨɨp.
Na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios na pai' dhuuk mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu ñi'ook chɨbɨɨp bhaan gu oidha' cham.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vupui; na gu' vaak na jix bhaan gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ bhaan gu vaak gu Israeel tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' oi'ñga' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chulhiiñdha' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam oi'ñga' mambhɨɨx gu ñi'ook mi' dhɨr kiicham ka't mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh ka't bhaan tu' gu novɨ gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu oidha' gu Israeel jix dhaas bhaan gu kavɨk gu bhóogɨt jix bhai'x bhaan ka't na ja'p kiicham saagi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ gu ñi'ook ka't na ja'p gu ñi'ook gu jodai' na jix uam ga'ra' gu novɨ; gio ba' ka't ki'ñgob.

Ba' jix aa' mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ bham; gio ba' gu mar gu chio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu vupui bɨɨx maatɨt jix dhaas gu i'ii'ñ bɨx tu'x tu'; na gu' na ba' tu'; jano' ba' jix duñia' bɨx gu vaak gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaak jodai mai' gu vaak; gio ba' jix duñia' mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ ga'ra' gu novɨ ka't novɨ maa'nkar; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr suudai' u'va ki'ñgob gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan tas buusñi jix tɨ'ɨ ki'ñgob gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim ga'ra' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia'; gio ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim ka't jixchamaam; mi' dhɨr ki'ñgob ju'ñdharan ba'k ki'ñgob gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ba'k ki'ñgob gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ba'k gook; gio ba' ki'ñgob ka't gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ki'ñgob bhaan tas buusñi ga'ra' vaik gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim baasɨ'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaik gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gio gu ñi'ook baasɨ'n.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook ba'k ki'ñgob mambhɨɨx; gio ba' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim novɨ maa'nkar baasɨ'n novɨ maa'nkar; gio ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim ga'ra' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam baasɨ'n.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ki'ñgob dɨr gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook ki'ñgob bhaan ki'ñgob.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bɨx xikoolh.
Jano' ba' dɨr gu ñi'ook ki'ñgob ba'k bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook ba'k ki'ñgob gu ñi'ook mambhɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu ñi'ook ki'ñgob xikoolh; gio ba' gu ñi'ook mi'p xikoolh gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr ka't gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook ka't gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim ka't xikoolh mii' dhɨr.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook kiki'ñgob gu ñi'ook ka't gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook dɨr gu ñi'ook ki'ñgob bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x mai' gu ñi'ook bhaan tas buusñi gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ki'ñgob ka't bhaan gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim jix duñia' vaik baasɨ'n vaik; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jix duñia' na ja'p gu ñi'ook ki'ñgob; mi' dhɨr mambhɨɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook u'u gat gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x jix duñia' jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook ki'ñgob ka't bhaan tas buusñi; gio ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kɨɨv; mi' dhɨr vupui bhaan mi'p u'u gat.
Jano' ba' ki'ñgob gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x ka't gu ñi'ook ki'ñgob gu ñi'ook; gio ba' tas buusñi; mi' dhɨr ki'ñgob gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mi' dhɨr bhaan saagi'ñ ki'ñgob bhaan saagi'ñ; gio ba' u'u gat jurtu'nka' dhi' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' ga'ra' gu ñi'ook xikoolh na ja'p gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook ka't mambhɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' kɨɨv bɨɨx jix duñia' vupui bhaan; gio ba' ga'ra' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x baasɨ'n.
Jano' ba' ka't ki'ñgob bhaan saagi'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x; gio ba' ki'ñgob bhaan saagi'ñ gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mi' dhɨr ki'ñgob saagi'ñ ki'ñgob saagi'ñ jurtu'nka' dhi' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jix duñia' jurtu'nka' dhi'; gio ba' ga'ra' gu ñi'ook xikoolh; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook ka't mambhɨɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook xikoolh jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' jixchamaam.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x; gio ba' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x bhaan tas buusñi ki'ñgob jurtu'nka' dhi' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jurtu'nka' dhi'; gio ba' ga'ra' gu ñi'ook xikoolh; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook ka't mambhɨɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x baasɨ'n; gio ba' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ki'ñgob gu ñi'ook jurtu'nka' dhi' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook xikoolh; gio ba' gu ñi'ook ka't mambhɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mai' bɨɨx gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x maa'n baasɨ'n; gio ba' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim ki'ñgob bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' maa'nkar tai bhaan.
Jano' ba' ba'k ki'ñgob ka't gook gu vaak na jix bhai' baasɨ'n gook na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan maa'nkar tai bhaan gu maa'nkar uañi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mai' ba'k ki'ñgob gu ñi'ook ka't gook gu vaak na jix bhai'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook ka't ba'k ki'ñgob gook gu vaak na jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' maakobh gu vaak na jix bhai' baasɨ'n maakobh gu vaak na jix bhai' baasɨ'n gu ñi'ook ki'ñgob; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak na jix bhai' bhaan.

Jano' ba' maakobh gu vaak na jix bhai' na ba' maa'nkar tai bhaan jix duñia' gu jodai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam novɨ maa'nkar tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook novɨ maa'nkar tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' novɨ maa'nkar; gio ba' bhaan jix duñia' bɨɨx maa'nkar tai bhaan gu maa'nkar.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx xikoolh; gio ba' bhaan gu vaak na jix bhai' gu chuukug gu maa'nkar.

Jano' ba' mai' ki'ñgob jix bhai'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu ñi'ook ki'ñgob gu ñi'ook mi'p gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim bhaan saagi'ñ; gio ba' ka't gu ñi'ook ki'ñgob tas buusñi bhaan gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' dhi' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan saagi'ñ jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan namki' jix nukadham vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan.

Jano' ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu ñi'ook jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan namki' jix nukadham jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; gio ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu ma'nkam gu Sadok mɨmɨim gu ma'nkam gu Lebii gu Jawatan na ba' gu vaak na jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jix duñia'; gio ba' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan ka't vupui bhaan gu vaak.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan jixchamaam baasɨ'n jixchamaam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook ki'ñgob vaik baasɨ'n vaik.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jix tɨ'ɨ; gio ba' ka't gu ñi'ook ju'ñdharan gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan baasɨ'n ka't gu ñi'ook vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook ki'ñgob ka't mambhɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' ki'ñgob jixchamaam baasɨ'n jixchamaam; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook oo'm gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x ki'ñgob gook; gio ba' ki'ñgob; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook ba'k kɨɨv.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gio gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan; gio ba' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr dhi' pai'.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaak jodai gu vaak; gio ba' maakobh gu ñi'ook gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim jix duñia' gu vaak xikoolh.

Jano' ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim jix duñia' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim bhaan gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu ñi'ook vaik gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu vaak xikoolh bhaan gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim cham gu vaak.

Jano' ba' ka't jix gɨ' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim jix bhai'x; gio ba' gu vaak gu bhóogɨt jix bhai'x xikoolh gu ñi'ook gu vaak; na ba' gu vaak ga'ra' gu ñi'ook jiix; jano' ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu vaak xikoolh; gio ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim ka't jixchamaam gu ñi'ook gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu vaak gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim ka't gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx xikoolh gu vaak.
Jano' ba' ki'ñgob gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim busaak gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' ki'ñgob bhaan gu ñi'ook ki'ñgob bhaan saagi'ñ; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook ka't jixchamaam bɨx xikoolh.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't vupui bhaan gu ñi'ook bhaan tas gei'ñ ka't; gio ba' jixchamaam gu ñi'ook xikoolh jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu ñi'ook jix duñia'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tas buusñi gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook ka't vupui bhaan ka't gu ñi'ook baasɨ'n gu ñi'ook; gio ba' vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook vaik baasɨ'n gu ñi'ook bɨx jix bhaan dhaas gu u'u xikoolh dɨr bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gio.
Jano' ba' tu jiim bhaan ki'ñgob bɨɨx ka'm gu vaak gu ñi'ook mai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu ñi'ook mai' jix bhɨɨ.
Jano' ba' ka't gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x; gio ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook ga'ra' gook gu vupui.
Jano' ba' gu vupui gu chio'ñ bhaan gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x baasɨ'n gu vupui maavɨt bhaan gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x baasɨ'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu vaak xikoolh.
Jano' ba' dɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx ka'm tu jiim ki'ñgob ka't gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x bɨx vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan ka't jix duñia' gu ñi'ook xidhuu ka't na ja'p gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu u'u ka't vaik gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gook; gio ba' gu vupui jix duñia' gu u'u; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' dhi' gu vaak na jix bhai' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan xidhuu ko'kmarak gook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gook kiki'ñgob gook kiki'ñgob; gio ba' gook kiki'ñgob gook.
Jano' ba' kiki'ñgob vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x na ja'p mi'p jix duñia' jix duu bhaan gu ñi'ook ba'k mai'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x baasɨ'n ba'k gu vaak.
Jano' ba' jix buusñi gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu ñi'ook gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim ka't vupui bhaan gu ñi'ook bhaan gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan ki'ñgob gu ñi'ook ka't gu ñi'ook mambhɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu ñi'ook ka't gu ñi'ook mi'p gu ñi'ook vaik.
Jano' ba' vupui bhaan gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mambhɨɨx baasɨ'n bɨɨx gu ñi'ook novɨ maa'nkar; gio ba' kiki'ñgob bhaan gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jix duñia'; na gu' gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Na gu' na gu' mi'p vaik gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham ko'kmarak na ja'p; na ba' jix duñia' tɨjɨɨ'ñ dɨr.
Jano' ba' vaak jodai ka't gu ñi'ook gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim ga'ra' mambhɨɨx jix duñia'.
Na gu' na gu' gu ñi'ook gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't mambhɨɨx; gio ba' vupui bhaan vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan ka't gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' bɨtaa'n gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim ka't ba'k gu ñi'ook gu ux na tu ibai' na ba' baakɨi dɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' vaak jodai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan tas buusñi gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan ka't gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't vupui bhaan ka't nɨidhim gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim mi'p bhaan gu ñi'ook jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook bɨx; gio ba' jurtu'nka' kiki'ñgob jurtu'nka' ba'k.
Jano' ba' jurtu'nka' kiki'ñgob gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim mi'p bhaan saagi'ñ ga'ra' ki'ñgob gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu bhóogɨt vupui bhaan vaak jodai bhaan tas buusñi ba'k.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu ñi'ook saagi'ñ vupui bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios jugi jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu ñi'ook jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu maa'nkar uañi'ñ; na gu' pai' jix bhaan.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan ba'k cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam pai' jix bhaan gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu vaak na jix bhai' na gu' jix bhaan Gɨ'kora'; gio ba' jajannulhi'ñ gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu jix duñia' gu vaak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix buusñi gu bhóogɨt ki'ñgob bhaan tas buusñi bɨx xikoolh.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu ux na tu ibai' bɨɨx jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jix duñia' xikoolh.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook saagi'ñ jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tas gei'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' maakobh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' jix duñia' vaak jodai bɨx xikoolh gu ñi'ook na ba' gu ñi'ook ai'chdhia' tɨjɨɨ'ñ xidhuu pai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ki'ñgob bhaan tas buusñi.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel bhaan tas buusñi; gio ba' ka't na ja'p mumua'da' gu suudai' gu oidha' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n kuiñcha gɇ'kamtu'nda'.

Na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook tu' ka't na ja'p gu ñi'ook na ja'p mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook tu' na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' cham tu' duu kiicham; gio ba' jix duñia' na ja'p gu ñi'ook tu' ju'ñdharan gɨ' suudai' jiim gu Kebar; mi' dhɨr bhaan gu vupui.
Jano' ba' gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Jawatan Dios chɨbiapui gu vaak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu bhóogɨt ki'ñgob tas buusñi.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ; gio ba' gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak.
Jano' ba' tu' maa'n ua'rgidhimɨk dɨr gu vaak; gio ba' gu chio'ñ ka't ju'ñdharan tu'.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu mar gu chio'ñ dhi' pai' gu ñi'ook pai' gu vaas tɨɨt gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel na ba' bɨɨx tas; mi' dhɨr cham pai' dhuuk gu vaak gu Israeel jix bhaan gu tɨɨgɨ' tu' gu gɨ'kora' bɨɨx gu chuukug koko'kam gu gɨ'kora' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ju'ñdharan cham tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' jix bhaan gu tɨɨgɨ' bɨɨx jix duu; gio ba' i'iich.
Jano' ba' jano' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' tu' duñiixim gu chuukug koko'kam gu gɨ'kora' tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Jano' ba' tu' gu mar gu chio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu Israeel dhi' gu vaak gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a uañi'ñ jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' tu' gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a bɨx jix duñia' gu ñi'ook tu jiim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak jix duñia' ba'k bɨx ñi'ook na tu a'ga; gio ba' vupui bhaan gu vupui na ba' jix duñia' bɨx duñia' bɨx tu duukam.
Jano' ba' dhi' ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu vaak; gio ba' bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kavɨk bɨx gu ñi'ook xikoolh ka't; mi' dhɨr dhi' ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu vaak.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jodai maa'nkar Jawatan novɨ maa'nkar; gio ba' baaso novɨ maa'nkar; mi' dhɨr jannulhi'ñ xikoolh; jano' ba' dhi' ka't jix bhai'x jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.
Jano' ba' dɨr baaso bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx ka'm pai' gook gu ñi'ook novɨ maa'nkar; gio ba' dɨr pai' jix ali' bɨɨx ka'm pai' jix gɨ' maakobh gu ñi'ook novɨ maa'nkar.
Jano' ba' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan maakobh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu jiim jodai maa'nkar Jawatan maakobh a'aa'.
Jano' ba' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan ga'ra' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' maakobh.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook maakobh tɨjɨɨ'ñ novɨ maa'nkar jannulhi'ñ xikoolh; gio ba' baaso novɨ maa'nkar bɨx; mi' dhɨr mi'p tas buusñi.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu mar gu chio'ñ tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu tanoolh ka't gu ñi'ook na ba' bhaan maa'nkar tai bhaan na ba' tu jiim bhaan gu ɨ'ɨr.
Jano' ba' maa'n jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas gu ma'nkam gu Sadok gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios na ba' tuur na ba'.
Jano' ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu ɨ'ɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maakobh a'aa' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan maakobh jannulhi'ñ xikoolh; gio ba' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim tuur gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jurtu'nka' ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu vaak mai' xidhuu.
Jano' ba' gook gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ chiiw cham na ba'; gio ba' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan na ja'p bɨɨx tuur.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tuur cham gu ñi'ook cham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan jix duñia' gu ñi'ook bhaan maa'nkar tai bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kɨɨv gu tanoolh maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan gu chio'ñ chiiw gu tanoolh; gio ba' maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan tuur gu ñi'ook cham kakneer.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kɨɨv gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu noobh.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook dhi' ja'tkam gu tanoolh jix bhai'x gu tanoolh jix duñia' maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan maa'nkar tai bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' boopoya' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu Tornoome bhaan ki'ñgob gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xidhuu bhaan tas buusñi; gio ba' ka't gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' dhi' ki'ñgob tu' gu ñi'ook; na gu' cham gu ñi'ook tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel chɨbiapui; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook.
Na ba' na ba' gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha'; gio ba' gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' jugi gu takarui' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu bhóogɨt ba'k ki'ñgob gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan ki'ñgob gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu vaak gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' bhaan gu vupui.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu mar gu chio'ñ jix dhaas gu i'ii'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu vupui bɨɨx maatɨt bɨx tu' chɨɨdaim bɨndak bhaan bɨx gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios bɨx ñi'ook na tu a'ga; mi' dhɨr jix dhaas gu i'ii'ñ ba'k gu vaak bɨx xidhuu.
Jano' ba' daipu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu Israeel; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr bɨx gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ tu' gu ñi'ook gu chuukug na ba' xidhuu na ba' gu vaak; gio ba' gu takarui' gu ɨ'ɨr; mi' dhɨr tu' ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨx.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook nuuka'n jir bɨx bhai' xidhuu.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu mar ja'tkam mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ tu' gu ñi'ook gu chuukug xidhuu bɨx gu ma'nkam gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Na pai' dhuuk gu Lebitas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' tu' na pai' dhuuk gu Israeel tu' duiñxim gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ka't gu vaak na jix bhai' xidhuu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kiki'ñgob gu vaak; gio ba' yaa' maa'nkar tai bhaan gu ja'tkam no'm vupui bhaan na ba' tu duu.

Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan duiñxim jix bɨɨx duu gu vaak gu Israeel gu ñi'ook gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim tu' na cham jir bhai'; na ba' gu ñi'ook gu novɨ gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' cham ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' na ba' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan tu' matgɨm jix bhaan Gɨ'kora'; gu' gu ñi'ook xi'ɨraam jix duu.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam nuuka'n jix nukadham gu vaak bɨx bhɨɨya' duñia'.

Na pai' dhuuk gu' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas gu ma'nkam gu Sadok nukadham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xidhuu na pai' dhuuk gu ma'nkam gu Israeel tu' ka't tu' na ba' vupui bhaan tu' no'm na ba' gu ɨ'ɨr tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' jɨjɨkgɨm xidhuu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak na jix bhai' na ba' nukadham.
Na pai' dhuuk ka't na pai' dhuuk ba'k gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kiki'ñgob jix bhai'x kutun; na pai' dhuuk cham bhaan na pai' dhuuk kiki'ñgob jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' ɨɨbhidham gu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham tu jiim na ba'.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam bɨɨx gu vaak na jix bhai' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim xidhuu kutun jajannulhi'ñ; gio ba' cham jix bhaan gu ja'tkam bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mo'o tu'; gu' gu ñi'ook bhaan ɨɨbhidham.
Na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan i'i suudai' u'va na pai' dhuuk baakɨi jix bhai'x.

Jano' ba' tu' ja'tkam na jix xoi'kam tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhɨɨ gu u'vɨ; gu' gu ñi'ook jix bhɨɨ gu ma'nkam gu vaak gu Israeel ja'tkam na jix xoi'kam ua'tulhi'ñ ja'tkam na jix xoi'kam jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix bhaan gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ na jix bhai' cham.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook no'm na ba' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jurtu'nka' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr ñi'ook na tu a'ga nukadham bɨx jix bhaan tas na jix bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ jix koi cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba'; gu' bhaan gu taat gu naan gu mar mar u'vɨ xibhɨk gu ja'tkam cham ka't jix duñia' gu chio'ñ.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook kɨɨv gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' gu tanoolh ba'k xidhuu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' gu vaak na jix bhai' xidhuu tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu maa'nkar; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' gu maa'nkar; mi' dhɨr cham gu maa'nkar gu Israeel; jano' ba' tu' jix duñia' gu maa'nkar.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu maa'nkar uañi'ñ jugi; gio ba' bɨx gu Israeel ka't.

Jano' ba' gu ux na tu ibai' bɨx dharka' bɨx gu maa'nkar bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx maa'nkar na jix maa ka't jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan; gio ba' gu ux na tu ibai' bɨx gu' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan na ba' gu ñi'ook gu vaak.
Jano' ba' matgɨm gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu u'uvhig na ja'p gu vaakax jugi jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mamai'chɨk gu oidha' gu maa'nkar na ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu oidha' gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x mambhɨɨx jix bhai'x; gio ba' dhi' ka't bɨx gu ñi'ook xikoolh.
Jano' ba' dhi' ka't na ba' xidhuu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook xikoolh; gio ba' mambhɨɨx na ba'.
Jano' ba' dhi' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook mambhɨɨx jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook xidhuu vaak na jix bhaan.

Jano' ba' jix bhaan dhi' gu oidha' ka't na ba' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu vaak na jix bhai' xidhuu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' ka' pai' na ba' gu vaak pai' jix bhaan na ba' xidhuu.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook mambhɨɨx jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook ka't na ba' gu Lebitas gu vaak na jix bhai' gu vaak gu maa'nkar bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim.

Jano' ba' na ba' gu maa'nkar kiicham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jixchamaam jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan jix ai'chdhix na ba' xidhuu; gio ba' ka't na ba' bɨx gu vaak gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' baasɨ'n gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' ka't ju'ñdharan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xidhuu baasɨ'n ju'ñdharan gu maa'nkar kiicham vupui bhaan xidhuu vupui bhaan gu maa'nkar kiicham dɨr gu ñi'ook bhaan tas gei'ñ bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook gu ux na tu ibai' bhaan tas buusñi; gio ba' gu ñi'ook ka't baasɨ'n dɨr gu ñi'ook tas gei'ñ bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook tas buusñi.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu oidha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu maa'nkar gu Israeel cham pai' dhuuk chiñia' gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu oidha' gu vaak gu Israeel bopxi'ñ.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook chiñia' gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr tɨtda:―Cha'pim gu ñi'ook; jano' ba' ñi'ook na jir bhai' bɨx bhai'; gio ba' bhaan gu ja'tkam tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx bhai' gu Epa bɨx bhai' gui'x.
Jano' ba' gu Epa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu ñi'ook; na jix duñia' gu ñi'ook baasɨ'n gu ñi'ook baasɨ'n gu Epa; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook ka't bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka't.
Jano' ba' dhi' ka't gu maa'nkar gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' baasɨ'n gu Epa tiriik baasɨ'n gu Epa kai' vaas.
Jano' ba' jir bɨx bhai' bɨ'ñdhatu' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨ'ñdhatu' gu ñi'ook baasɨ'n gu jodai' na jix uam; gio ba' mambhɨɨx jix duu gu ñi'ook; na gu' mambhɨɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ali' karneer gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Israeel na ba' gu maa'nkar na ba' maa'nkar tai bhaan na ba' gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam gu oidha' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' gu maa'nkar na ba' gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu Israeel.

Gu' gu' gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'nkar tai bhaan gu maa'nkar gu vaak na jix bhai' tas na jix bhaan bɨx gu vaak gu Israeel; gio ba' gu ñi'ook maa'nkar tai bhaan na ba' gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'n gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim tuur cham xidhuu.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix bhɨɨ gu ɨ'ɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu vaak bhaan maakobh gu ñi'ook jodai maa'nkar Jawatan bhaan kiki'ñgob.
Jano' ba' jix duu kɨɨv gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu vaak.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'n gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh gui'x gakdhi'ñchix kɨɨv gu tanoolh; gio ba' jugi gu takarui' cham jabka'.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu ja'tkam gu oidha' tuur uañi'ñ.
Jano' ba' kɨɨv gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'nkar tai bhaan gu Jawatan Dios kɨɨv ali' vaakax kɨɨv gu chuukug cham gu tanoolh kɨɨv gu tanoolh; gio ba' uañi'ñ gu chio'ñ chiiw gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx tuur gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Epa bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu Epa; gio ba' gu Epa bɨ'ñdhatu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kɨɨv na ja'p dhi' ja'tkam kɨɨv gu tanoolh maa'nkar tai bhaan bɨ'ñdhatu'.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' ki'ñgob gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tas buusñi gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh tu jiim gu tanoolh juanda' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr bhi'spio'kai gio gu tanoolh gu masad.

Jano' ba' gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu bhóogɨt ki'ñgob gu ñi'ook ki'ñgob jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan jix duu maa'nkar tai bhaan jix duñia' ba'k ki'ñgob; gio ba' mi' dhɨr; gu' cham gu ñi'ook ki'ñgob bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu ja'tkam gu oidha' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios ba'k ki'ñgob tas na jix bhaan.
Jano' ba' maa'nkar tai bhaan gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu tanoolh juanda' ka't ali' karneer cham gu ñi'ook cham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Epa bɨɨx gu ñi'ook; gio ba' bɨɨx mar kaneer gu novɨ bɨ'ñdhatu' bɨɨx gu Epa.
Gu' gu' gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu masad tuur cham ali' karneer gu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Epa bɨɨx tuur gu Epa bɨɨx gu ñi'ook; gu' bɨɨx ali' karneer jurtu'nka'; mi' dhɨr bɨ'ñdhatu' gu Epa.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' ba'k gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu bhóogɨt ki'ñgob; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt.

Na pai' dhuuk gu' na pai' dhuuk gu ja'tkam gu oidha' ba'k vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ba'k ki'ñgob gu ñi'ook ki'ñgob saagi'ñ; gio ba' ba'k ki'ñgob saagi'ñ ki'ñgob gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr cham gu ñi'ook ki'ñgob pai' chɨbiapui gu ñi'ook.
Na pai' dhuuk gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' na pai' dhuuk ba'k gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ; na pai' dhuuk.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu Epa bɨɨx tuur gu Epa bɨɨx gu ñi'ook; gio ba' bɨɨx ali' karneer; mi' dhɨr bɨ'ñdhatu' bɨɨx gu Epa.

Na pai' dhuuk gu' na pai' dhuuk gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' namkidhat jix duñia' maa'nkar tai bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios bhi'spio'kai ki'ñgob tas buusñi maa'nkar tai bhaan na ja'p duñia' gu tanoolh juanda'; gio ba' mi' dhɨr; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook ki'ñgob mi' dhɨr.
Jano' ba' maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu tanoolh maa'nkar tai bhaan mar kaneer oi'ñga' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu xibh maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam sɨlhkam baasɨ'n gu Epa baasɨ'n bɨ'ñdhatu' na ba' bɨɨx; gio ba' na ba' gu Jawatan Dios ñi'ook kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mar kaneer bɨ'ñdhatu' sɨlhkam maa'nkar tai bhaan gu vaak na jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu maa'nkar oi'ñdha' gu ma'nkam ka't; mi' dhɨr gu maa'nkar ka't.
Gu' gu' tu' gu maa'nkar gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oi'ñdha' tu duukam ka't bɨɨx ka'm oi'ñga' gu ñi'ook gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha'; gu' ka't gu ma'nkam.

Jano' ba' gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' cham jix bhɨɨ cham tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook cham jix duñia' gu maa'nkar; gio ba' bia'ka' maa'n gu ma'nkam; na ba' gu ja'tkam cham ka't baas maa'n gu maa'nkar.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mi' dhɨr ba'k ka't bhaan ki'ñgob gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu ñi'ook ka't pai' tas gei'ñ.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' dhi' pai' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam uañi'ñ; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook cham jix buusñi na ba' jix bhaan gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' jix buusñi gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maakobh; gio ba' gu ñi'ook ka't naadat.
Jano' ba' maakobh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't tɨtda:―Aañ oo'm gu ñi'ook; gio ba' ko'kmarak gu ñi'ook bɨx maakobh.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xikoolh bɨx maakobh xikoolh.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam pai' gu vaak gu maa'nkar gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ba'k gu vaak; gio ba' gu suudai' jix buus bɨtaa'n gu vaak bhaan tas buusñi; na gu' gu vaak ka't tas buusñi; jano' ba' gu suudai' jix dhaav bɨtaa'n bhaan gu ñi'ook gu vaak saagi'ñ jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jix duu jix buusñi gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu bhóogɨt ki'ñgob gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt mai' ki'ñgob mai' gu bhóogɨt tas buusñi; gio ba' gu suudai' jix buus gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gamai' gu chio'ñ bhaan tas buusñi ga'ra' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ; gio ba' jix bhai'x tu' jix duu gu ñi'ook gu suudai' bɨɨx ka'm.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x tu' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' bɨɨx ka'm kɨkbok; gio ba' jix bhai'x tu' jix duu gu ñi'ook gu suudai' bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x tu' jix duu tu' cham gu tanoolh na jix bhai' gu ñi'ook; na gu' gu suudai' jix duu cham gu ñi'ook.
